title: Harmonic Progressions in K-Pop
gloss: A computational music analysis of K-pop that uses Spotify data and machine learning classifiers to study how musical features like key, tonality, chord progressions and timbre distinguish K-pop from Western pop music and relate to song success.

title: Learning Disabilities and Kids' Media
gloss: A creative project developing a children's webseries, planned as an audio drama, about siblings with dyslexia, informed by ethnographic fieldwork at a school for dyslexic students. It explores positive disability representation and how to create relatable children's media for and about kids with learning disabilities.

title: Analysis of Star-Forming Galaxy Development through Emission Line Spectra
gloss: Studies how distant star-forming galaxies evolve by analyzing faint neutral oxygen emission lines in their spectra, comparing early-universe galaxies with nearby ones on emission-line diagnostic diagrams and photoionization models to understand the ionization processes, shocks and diffuse gas shaping galaxy evolution.

title: The vanguard portrait: Isabel Villaseñor
gloss: An art history study of Mexican modernist artist Isabel (Chabela) Villasenor, examining how her woodcuts, photographs, and film built a public persona around race, mestizaje, indigeneity, motherhood, and sexuality in post-revolutionary Mexico, addressing the overlooked role of women in Mexican modernism and national identity.

title: Hydrology or Physiology: Deconvolving Mechanisms for d2H Fractionation in Arctic Plant Waxes
gloss: Studies hydrogen isotopes in Arctic willow leaf waxes and the waters plants use across a growing season in Greenland, to explain why Arctic waxes depart from global calibrations and to improve leaf wax records of past precipitation and Arctic climate.

title: Postcolonial Prestige
gloss: A literary studies project on Sri Lankan Anglophone fiction and literary prizes, examining how prizewinning postwar novels address a fractured national identity and challenge postcolonial literary theory, with attention to the sociology of the Gratiaen Prize.

title: Depersonalization/Derealization Disorder Captured Through Oil Painting
gloss: An art project creating a series of oil paintings that depict the experience of depersonalization/derealization disorder, a dissociative mental health condition, drawing on literature and interviews with people who have the disorder and clinicians to raise awareness and reduce stigma.

title: Music Tempo and Imagined Stories
gloss: A music psychology experiment on how tempo, major/minor mode and genre (a march and a waltz) affect the stories and scenes listeners imagine while hearing music, finding that pieces played at their original tempo prompted more, easier and more vivid narratives.

title: Xenobiotic and differentiation associated AhR translocation in epithelial tissue homeostasis
gloss: Cell biology research on how the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) moves within skin cells during responses to toxic chemicals and during normal skin cell differentiation, using imaging and gene expression experiments, with relevance to skin diseases like psoriasis, atopic dermatitis and chloracne.

title: Investigating the Effects of DOPA Crosslinks on the Mechanical Properties of Mussel Foot Protein 5
gloss: Molecular simulations of a mussel adhesive protein (mussel foot protein 5) testing how water content and tyrosine/DOPA crosslinking affect its strength and toughness, to inform bio-inspired underwater adhesives and hydrogels for wound healing.

title: The Impact of Climate Change on Energy Poverty: Evidence from the European Union, 2004-2019
gloss: An economics study of how climate change affects energy poverty, meaning households' difficulty affording heating, cooling and utilities, across European Union countries. It uses Eurostat data and heating and cooling degree-days to examine inequality between member states and policy responses.

title: Galactic Data's Journey: Unveiling Universe's Hidden Narratives
gloss: Astronomy research testing spectral stacking, a technique that combines spectra of many similar galaxies to detect faint emission lines, and whether stacked results accurately reflect individual galaxy properties such as gas density and chemical abundances, using Keck and James Webb Space Telescope survey data to study distant galaxies and galaxy evolution.

title: Paleotemperature Reconstruction of the Younger Dryas and the Early Holocene using Sediment Core Proxies from Lake N14, South Greenland
gloss: Reconstructs past summer temperatures in South Greenland during the Younger Dryas cold period and early Holocene using lake sediment cores, chironomid fossils and XRF geochemistry, to understand past climate change and ocean circulation and improve future climate projections.

title: Does Joint Engagement Relate to Toddlers' Language Abilities Even in Diverse Home Environments?
gloss: Child language development research examining whether parent-toddler joint engagement during play relates to toddlers' vocabulary after accounting for socioeconomic status and sibling status, using recordings of mothers and toddlers playing at home.

title: A History of Women in Documentary
gloss: An online interactive timeline of fifteen American women documentary filmmakers from 1920 to 2021, combining original writing and research on their films and lives. The project examines women's contributions to documentary film history and broadens ideas of who can be a documentary filmmaker.

title: Investigating Relationships between Asthma Mortalities, Environmental Factors, and Social Determinants in Chicago
gloss: Studies how air pollution and social determinants of health relate to asthma deaths across Chicago neighborhoods, combining medical examiner records, high-resolution fine particulate matter data, and census demographic and housing data in a regression analysis of racial and environmental health disparities.

title: Home to Home: How a Yemeni Refugee Found Love in South Korea (Documentary Film) Description
gloss: A documentary film about Yemeni refugees on Jeju Island, South Korea, following a Yemeni refugee and his Korean wife as they run an Arabic restaurant, navigate cultural integration and family traditions, and face his uncertain legal status.

title: Use of Languages in Edward Yang's Yi Yi: Exploring the Local and the Foreign in Taiwan New Cinema
gloss: A film studies analysis of multilingual dialogue in Edward Yang's Yi Yi, examining how Hokkien, Mandarin, Japanese, English and French signal local versus foreign identity and colonial influence in Taiwan New Cinema and Taiwanese society.

title: Of Things That Shouldn't Be (Cinematic Poetry) Description and Artist Statement
gloss: A cinematic poetry short film exploring Paulo Freire's critique of banking education, where students passively absorb knowledge, and the desire to break free from it. The work pairs an abstract poem with open-ended visuals meant to invite multiple interpretations.

title: Determining Spatial Distribution and Thermal Properties of the Interstellar Medium in the Local Bubble
gloss: Astrophysics research on the interstellar medium in the Local Bubble around the Sun, combining neutral hydrogen absorption measurements toward pulsars with 3D dust maps to locate cold gas structures and estimate their thermal pressure and ionization.

title: Student Learning and Teacher Pedagogy: Emergent Forms of Collaborative Learning
gloss: An ethnographic study of collaborative, equity-centered learning in a YWCA summer youth program that uses storytelling, music-making, STEAM projects and culture, examining how students and teachers share expertise and how program design and non-punitive approaches shape engagement.

title: "The Walking Axis:" An Interactive Audio-Tour Performance into Beijing Memory
gloss: A site-specific interactive audio-tour performance along imperial Beijing's historic central axis, combining outdoor theatre, oral storytelling, dance and roleplay to explore the city's cultural history, urban memory and modernization, and the participatory potential of performance in public spaces.

title: Accelerated Dynamic Average Consensus
gloss: Simulation study of how one-way (asymmetric) communication links affect the stability and convergence speed of an accelerated dynamic average consensus algorithm, used by networks of agents such as sensor networks or robot swarms to track the average of changing signals.

title: Asymmetric Systems with State Symmetry
gloss: A physics project on converse symmetry breaking in classical mechanics, studying how geometric asymmetry in objects like spinning tops, seesaws and floating rafts can make their equilibria more stable. It uses numerical simulation and stability analysis of the equations of motion.

title: Language Influence from Siblings
gloss: Studies how older siblings shape the language development of younger children in Spanish-English bilingual homes, using parent interviews and vocabulary checklists to compare the Spanish and English vocabularies of children with and without older siblings.

title: Potassium Specific Vesicle Based Sensor
gloss: Development of a fluorescent nanosensor built from lipid vesicles with membrane ion transporters that selectively detects extracellular potassium ions over other cations, tested by measuring potassium levels in bacterial cultures. A biosensor and bioengineering approach to ion detection relevant to disease monitoring.

title: Reasons for Exercise, Body Image, & Mood
gloss: A psychology study of how online fitness classes affect young women's mood and body image, applying objectification theory to test whether body surveillance during exercise and appearance-based versus mood or function reasons for exercising shape those benefits.

title: Splice Factors leading to SCN1A disorder
gloss: Genetics research on Dravet syndrome, a severe childhood epilepsy linked to the SCN1A sodium channel gene, studying how intronic variants cause inclusion of a poison exon through alternative splicing and identifying the splicing proteins that bind the region.

title: Case study of NY Climate Legislation
gloss: An energy policy analysis of New York's Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act, evaluating whether the state's electricity grid can meet its renewable energy and clean energy targets, such as solar, offshore wind and net-zero emissions goals, using data on grid capacity and projections of future generation.

title: Epistulae Ex Ponto and Writing Nostalgia
gloss: A Classics study of nostalgia and exile in the Roman poet Ovid's letters from Tomis, the Epistulae ex Ponto, examining how letter writing expresses longing for Rome. The research is also adapted into a graphic novel retelling the letters for general readers.

title: Irish Language Revitalization
gloss: Compares Irish language revitalization movements in the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland, examining how nationalism, colonial identity conflict and stage of decolonization shape the success of endangered language revival.

title: Competitive Intramolecular H-bonding
gloss: Organic and physical chemistry research using variable-temperature NMR spectroscopy to study how intramolecular hydrogen bonding controls the conformations of phenolic Mannich bases in solution, including how solvent polarity disrupts the hydrogen bond, with relevance to drug design.

title: TCM Meaning and Efficacy
gloss: A medical anthropology study, based on interviews with practitioners and patients at Chicago-area clinics, of how Traditional Chinese Medicine is translated into biomedical terms in Western settings and how this shapes patient-practitioner trust and the treatment's effectiveness.

title: Leyendo Juntos Booksharing Observation
gloss: Observational study of parent-child shared book reading in Latino families, comparing how Spanish-speaking parents read English versus bilingual Spanish-English books with their children, to understand early language and literacy support and inform culturally responsive literacy programs.

title: Melanopsin's Role in Threat Learning
gloss: A neuroscience study in mice of how melanopsin-expressing retinal cells in the visual system help animals learn to anticipate threats, tracing a brain circuit from the retina to fear- and reward-related regions and finding sex differences in threat learning.

title: A new selective OAT inactivator
gloss: Medicinal chemistry project designing and synthesizing a new mechanism-based inactivator of the enzyme ornithine aminotransferase (OAT), a potential drug target for hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer), by modifying the existing inhibitor BisCF3 to improve potency.

title: Fracturing in drying drops
gloss: Physics of cracks and dimples that form as droplets of colloidal suspensions (particles in solution, as in paints and inks) dry. The project builds Python and OpenCV computer vision software that automatically detects and measures crack and dimple patterns in images of drying drops.

title: Pregnancy, Microbiome, and Inflammation
gloss: Compares the gut microbiome and immune function markers of pregnant and non-pregnant women in Cebu, Philippines, using fecal samples, blood spots and bacterial gene sequencing, to understand how gut bacteria relate to immune changes and inflammation during pregnancy in a non-Western population.

title: Bioconjugate Vaccine Production in vitro
gloss: Develops a low-cost, freeze-dried cell-free system for making glycoconjugate vaccines against bacterial infections at the point of care, engineering the sugar-transferring enzyme PglB to handle more pathogens' sugar antigens and creating a cheaper, heat-stable formulation that avoids refrigerated distribution.

title: US Indian Diaspora and Hindu Nationalism
gloss: A political science survey study of Indian American attitudes toward Hindu nationalism (Hindutva), using regression analysis to identify predictors such as religious identity, Islamophobia and assimilation, and proposing an index for measuring Hindu nationalist sentiment in the US diaspora.

title: Who Can Be Body Positive on Instagram?
gloss: A psychology experiment on how women react to body positivity posts on Instagram depending on the model's race and body size. Using mock Instagram posts featuring fat or thin, Black or White models, it examines inclusivity, anti-fat bias and race in the social media body positivity movement.

title: Impact of Accented Speech on Language
gloss: A developmental psychology study of how hearing an unfamiliar non-native (Turkish) accent affects preschoolers' word recognition and language comprehension, and whether supportive sentence context helps, measured with eye-tracking in 4- and 5-year-olds.

title: Grouping in Visualization Interpretation
gloss: A data visualization and perception study using crowdsourced experiments to examine how chart type (dot plots, line charts, heatmaps) shapes which patterns viewers notice and what conclusions they draw, aiming toward guidelines for choosing charts that communicate an intended message.

title: Food Cues and the DMNV
gloss: A neuroscience study in mice of brain-to-gut communication, identifying which brain regions activate in response to food cues (sight and smell) and may signal the gut via the dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus to prepare for digestion.

title: Role of Emoji Usage in Text Messaging
gloss: A psycholinguistics experiment on how face emojis shape the interpretation of ambiguous text messages, comparing messages from friends versus acquaintances, to understand emojis as pragmatic cues that reduce miscommunication in written online communication.

title: Chinese Women Students in US Colleges
gloss: A sociology study of how women Chinese international students at US colleges experience their intersectional identities and how those identities shape socializing and belonging with American peers, using surveys and interviews to examine cross-cultural adaptation and coping strategies.

title: Dual Risk Factors for Dementia
gloss: Studies how combined hearing loss and mild cognitive impairment affect conversation in older adults, comparing communication breakdowns with and without hearing aids and surveying care partners on caregiver burden. Aims to inform hearing treatment and aural rehabilitation for people with both conditions.

title: Optimization of Potent nNOS Inhibitors
gloss: Medicinal chemistry project synthesizing small-molecule inhibitors of neuronal nitric oxide synthase (nNOS), an enzyme linked to neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's, and modifying their structure to improve blood-brain barrier permeability while keeping potency and selectivity, as a step toward drug candidates.

title: Education and COVID-19
gloss: A qualitative sociology study of how the COVID-19 pandemic changed public perceptions of teachers and the education system, based on interviews with parents and teachers of public high school students about remote learning, the role of teachers, and the value of education during a public health crisis.

title: Gender & Race: GQNB Experiences
gloss: A qualitative psychology study using interviews with genderqueer and non-binary college students to examine how gender and racial identities intersect, exploring the stereotypes, societal norms and expectations they navigate, including queer normativity and whiteness, and how they resist or conform to them.

title: LEDs & Public Health
gloss: Models how replacing incandescent light bulbs with LEDs across the continental United States would cut electricity demand and power plant emissions, improve air quality, and reduce premature deaths. Uses emissions, atmospheric chemistry, and health impact models to inform energy efficiency and lighting policy.

title: Play About Income Inequality
gloss: An original two-act play about income inequality and class in America, told through the friendship between a working-class driving instructor and a high school student. The script draws on research into working-class life and interviews with real driving instructors, and a scene was shared as a staged reading.

title: Ugandan Queer Migration
gloss: An anthropology study of queer Ugandan migrants and refugees fleeing anti-LGBTQ persecution, using interviews with asylum seekers and news media analysis to examine the asylum process, community life in host countries, ties to Uganda, and the formation of a queer diaspora.

title: Early Movements in Cerebral Palsy
gloss: Video analysis of arm, leg and joint movements in young infants at high risk of cerebral palsy, comparing infants with and without the diagnosis to find movement patterns, such as limb lifting and coupled joint motions, that could support early detection of CP.

title: Toxic Chemotherapy on Proprioception
gloss: Tracks how oxaliplatin chemotherapy neurotoxicity affects cancer patients' proprioception and movement over the course of treatment, using a portable shoulder force-matching test, strength measures and quality-of-life questionnaires to assess sensorimotor decline.

title: Feelings, States, and Child Language
gloss: A longitudinal study of how caregivers' talk about feelings and mental states during play with toddlers, together with toddlers' expressive language, relates to children's emerging metacognition and emotion regulation later in early childhood, comparing typically developing toddlers and late talkers to inform social-emotional interventions.

title: Disease Diagnostic Protein Circuits
gloss: Development of a rapid, ultrasensitive point-of-care diagnostic that detects disease biomarker proteins and small molecules using a self-amplifying split adenylate cyclase protein network with positive feedback, combining computational ODE modeling of the protein circuit with optimization of recombinant protein expression in E. coli.

title: Threadpainting Light
gloss: An art project that embroiders and paints photographs of manmade Mississippi landscapes, using natural pigments gathered from each site, to examine how whiteness, race, gender and Southern land use have shaped the environment and its history.

title: Role of the SEC in Differentiation
gloss: Molecular biology study of how transcription elongation, regulated by the Super Elongation Complex and RNA polymerase II, drives skin stem cell differentiation. Identifies the transcription factor ATF3 as a SEC target that promotes epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and suppresses proliferation.

title: Body Positivity in the Ballet Industry
gloss: An interview study of collegiate ballet dancers on body image, examining how the ideal "ballet body" is instilled and reinforced, how weight-based expectations contribute to eating disorders, and why the Body Positivity Movement has failed to change the professional ballet industry.

title: Categorizing Riverside Park
gloss: An urban studies project on how people use and relate to New York City's Riverside Park, based on observations, readings and interviews, examining community ownership, competing agendas, and the park's scenic landmark designation, and proposing policy changes to prioritize preservation and infrastructure over outdated aesthetic standards.

title: Incubation Periods and Problem Solving
gloss: A psychology experiment testing whether sleep or staying awake during an incubation period, time spent away from an unsolved problem, better improves creative problem solving, with sleep's role in memory consolidation and reorganization as the proposed mechanism.

title: Portrayals of Colombian Immigration
gloss: A history project examining how U.S. media coverage of the cocaine drug trade from 1979 to 1990 created a drug trafficking stigma against Colombian immigrants, connecting this ethnic stereotyping to American views of Colombia's role in the War on Drugs.

title: Basal Ganglia Connectivity in PPA
gloss: Uses functional MRI to compare connectivity between the basal ganglia and the brain's language network in two subtypes of primary progressive aphasia, a neurodegenerative language disorder caused by Alzheimer's disease or frontotemporal degeneration.

title: SCLC cell detection using ML
gloss: Develops image-analysis and machine learning methods to track cell motion and distinguish cell phenotypes in small cell lung cancer, using optical flow on time-lapse microscopy images to study tumor cell plasticity and heterogeneity.

title: Thermostable Cell-Free Vaccine Synthesis
gloss: Improving a freeze-dried, cell-free system for making glycoconjugate vaccines against bacterial infections at the point of care, by engineering the sugar-transferring enzyme to handle more bacterial sugar antigens and developing a low-cost formulation that stays stable without refrigeration.

title: Family, Aggression, and Psychopathology
gloss: A child psychology study of how parenting practices relate to children's aggression and rule-breaking behavior, and whether family and neighborhood socioeconomic status changes those links, using caregiver surveys about school-age youth.

title: Thermal Adaptations in Drosophila
gloss: Studies the genetic basis of how temperature preference evolved in fruit flies (Drosophila melanogaster) as they spread from Africa to Europe, using behavioral thermal preference tests on wild strains and recombinant inbred lines to map genes behind behavioral adaptation to new climates.

title: Water-Soluble Dynamic Complex Synthesis
gloss: Synthetic inorganic chemistry project designing water-soluble, stimuli-responsive metal-organic complexes using the Weak-Link Approach, with hemilabile ligands that switch states reversibly in water, aiming toward reconfigurable DNA architectures. Involves ligand synthesis and characterization by NMR, X-ray crystallography and mass spectrometry.

title: Rheoelectric Rheometer Attachement
gloss: Builds a custom electrical attachment for a rheometer to measure capacitance and flow behavior (rheology) of carbon black slurries at the same time, for semi-solid flow batteries used in grid-scale renewable energy storage.

title: Lunfardo, Tango, and Italian Immigrants
gloss: A history of Italian immigrants in late 19th and early 20th century Buenos Aires, Argentina, and how they navigated being both welcomed and stigmatized, using newspapers and tango lyrics to examine immigrant slang like lunfardo and cocoliche, local identities, and tenement community life.

title: Representation in Precision Medicine
gloss: Computational genomics study of how genetic variants and DNA methylation affect gene expression in liver cells from African American donors, using methQTL and eQTM analyses to find population-specific factors in drug response and disease for more inclusive precision medicine.

title: Narrative Psych: Mental/Phys Health
gloss: A narrative psychology study comparing how people tell life stories about mental versus physical health challenges, using thematic coding of personal narratives and linking narrative themes to psychological well-being.

title: Neuron and mast cell interaction in RDEB
gloss: Studies the causes of chronic itch in recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, a genetic skin blistering disease, using a mouse model to examine skin inflammation, immune cells such as mast cells and neutrophils, and itch- and pain-related gene expression in skin and sensory neurons.

title: Environmental (In)Justice in Chicago
gloss: An environmental justice study of heavy metal contamination in Chicago soil and water, testing whether pollution from current and historical industry falls disproportionately on neighborhoods with more people of color and lower-income residents, using chemical analysis, GIS mapping and Census data.

title: Polymer Science: Curing the Incurable
gloss: Designs protein-like polymers that mimic parts of the Nrf2 protein to block its interaction with Keap1, a protein-protein interaction involved in neurodegenerative disease. The project synthesizes and characterizes these polymers as a potential therapeutic and plans to test their binding, pathway activation and off-target effects.

title: Alcohol Laws and Campus Drinking Culture
gloss: A history of how Evanston's changing alcohol laws and drinking age in the 1970s and 80s shaped Northwestern University's campus drinking culture, using alumni oral history interviews and archival research to examine fraternity power, binge drinking and gender-based violence.

title: Mechanism of TLR4 Signal Induction
gloss: Immunology and molecular biology research on how the immune receptor TLR4 is activated, using CRISPR gene knockdowns and flow cytometry to test candidate genes for a proposed inhibitory protein complex. The work aims to inform treatments for TLR4-linked diseases such as cancer and sepsis.

title: Chinese Loans infrastructure in Kenya
gloss: Interview-based study of how ordinary Kenyans perceive Chinese loans and investments in Kenyan infrastructure, drawing on conversations with 174 people across four counties to capture local, bottom-up views of Chinese-funded development and debt.

title: PA spreading and decay in the brain
gloss: Optimizes the injection site and concentration of a self-assembling peptide amphiphile nanomaterial delivered into the mouse brain, measuring how it spreads, as groundwork for using it as a scaffold to regenerate dopamine neurons in a Parkinson's disease model.

title: Alternative Mechanisms of Psychosis
gloss: A neuroscience study in mice of how excess dopamine in the striatum drives behaviors linked to schizophrenia's positive, negative and cognitive symptoms, testing the separate roles of D1- and D2-receptor neurons to find better treatments for symptoms that antipsychotics do not help.

title: Measuring Risk-Sharing in Thailand
gloss: A development economics study of how households in rural and peri-urban Thailand use informal insurance and borrowing from relatives, neighbors and moneylenders to share financial risk, testing full insurance theory with household survey data and examining moral hazard and responses to health shocks.

title: Plasmonic Copper Photocatalyst Synthesis
gloss: Synthesizes and characterizes supported plasmonic copper nanoparticle photocatalysts for light-driven dry methane reforming, which converts methane and carbon dioxide greenhouse gases into syngas. The project varies metal oxide supports and copper loading to find catalysts for low-temperature, energy-efficient syngas production.

title: Queer Health Education
gloss: A sociology study of how high-school health and sex education addresses LGBTQ students and gender and sexual identity, using interviews with queer alumni and health educators and analysis of New Jersey school health curricula to examine queer inclusion and heteronormative framing.

title: Factor Analysis of Neuroticism
gloss: Psychometric study testing whether a short neuroticism questionnaire validly measures the personality trait in adolescents, using factor analysis to examine its anxiety and depression components and fairness across demographic groups, to support prevention of teen anxiety and depression.

title: The Lasting Legacy of a Divided City
gloss: A history and music research project on how the Berlin Wall, divided Germany and reunification affected Berlin's classical orchestras during the 1988-1991 transition period, drawing on German-language archival sources to make the topic accessible to English speakers.

title: CS-Mimetic PA Cell Coatings
gloss: Develops self-assembling peptide amphiphile biomaterials that mimic chondroitin sulfate and coat the surface of human cartilage cells, testing whether these coatings boost cartilage-forming activity to improve chondrocyte transplantation treatments for cartilage degeneration.

title: Role of TLR7 and 9 in Alloimmunization
gloss: Immunology research in mice on how the innate immune system drives antibody formation against foreign red blood cell antigens after blood transfusion, focusing on how stored red blood cells activate dendritic cells through Toll-like receptors and MyD88 signaling.

title: Trans Students Define "Having Sex"
gloss: A qualitative interview study of how transgender and non-binary college students define "having sex" and what shapes those definitions, examining gender identity and sexual experience, with implications for sex education, sexual health research, and college support for student sexual well-being.

title: Colonial Roots in Chicago Anthro.
gloss: A historical study of William Jones, a Meskwaki anthropologist and the first Indigenous person in the US to earn a PhD in anthropology, and his place at Chicago's Field Museum. It looks at the colonial history of early anthropology and museums and at Indigenous and marginalized scholars. The work became a public digital history essay and an annotated historical map of Chicago.

title: Bisexual Relationship Perception
gloss: A social psychology study of bias against bisexual people in dating, testing how straight and gay participants perceive the stability, fidelity and communication of romantic relationships that include a bisexual partner. It replicates a 1997 study to see whether these stereotypes persist amid greater LGBTQ+ acceptance.

title: Young Supernovae Sample from ZTF
gloss: Builds a large sample of young Type Ia supernovae discovered by the Zwicky Transient Facility, with early light curve observations taken within days of explosion, to study the progenitor systems and formation channels of these supernovae.

title: Non-Traditional Recumbent Tricycle Steering
gloss: Develops an alternative steering system for recumbent tricycles to make cycling accessible to people with limited upper body mobility, comparing sensors such as touch sensors and joysticks for converting body motion into steering control. An assistive technology and adaptive recreation engineering project.

title: Representation of Muslims in Middle-grade and Young Adult Fiction
gloss: A literary analysis of how Muslim youth are portrayed in middle-grade and young adult fiction, surveying books with Muslim protagonists to examine identity, assimilation, Islamic values in storytelling, and the need for admirable role-model characters for young minority readers.

title: Probing the Relationship Between Signaling Peptides and Cell Receptors in Dynamic Biomaterials
gloss: Designs dynamic peptide-based biomaterials that mimic the extracellular matrix, where growth-factor-mimicking peptides move along self-assembling nanofibers to reach cells and activate receptor signaling. Aimed at regenerative medicine and tissue repair, with tests on human cells.

title: Poetry Creating a Pathway to the Past
gloss: A creative writing project of first-person poems voicing local Black women activists of the civil rights movement, drawn from oral histories and archival research, to center women overlooked in Black social movement history and connect Black women today to their ancestral lineage.

title: Mouse Behavioral Planning in a Naturalistic Prey-Predator Task
gloss: Studies planning and foraging behavior in mice using a naturalistic arena task where mice search among obstacles for water rewards while evading a robot predator. Compares a new dynamic-reward task to an earlier fixed-reward version to see how reward unpredictability changes navigation and predator interactions.

title: Increasing Representation in Precision Medicine: Investigating the Impact of DNA Methylation on Gene Expression in African-Americans
gloss: Computational genomics study of how genetic variants and DNA methylation (epigenetics) affect gene expression in liver cells from African American donors, aiming to improve diversity in precision medicine and understand population differences in drug response and disease.

title: Examining the Relationship Between Identity Development and Psychopathology in a Diverse Sample of Children and Young Adolescents
gloss: A developmental psychology study of how identity development processes, such as exploration and commitment, relate to mental health symptoms like anxiety, depression, aggression and somatic complaints in late childhood and early adolescence, and whether race/ethnicity, socioeconomic status or sex affect these links.

title: Hearing Loss as a Modifiable Risk Factor for Dementia
gloss: Studies how hearing loss combined with mild cognitive impairment affects conversation in older adults, comparing conversation breakdowns with and without hearing aids and surveying care partners about caregiver burden, to inform hearing treatment and aural rehabilitation for people with both conditions.

title: Numerical Study of Average Performance of Distributed Optimization Algorithms
gloss: Simulation study of a self-healing distributed optimization algorithm for networked systems, testing how network connectivity, topology and packet loss affect its average convergence rate on logistic regression problems across random graph models.

title: Slavery in the Saturnalia: An exploration of Macronius' Saturnalia
gloss: A classics and late antiquity history paper comparing how slavery is depicted in Macrobius' Saturnalia and Augustine's City of God, examining how pagan and Christian writers in the late Roman Empire justified slavery and denied enslaved people's personhood through ideas of natal alienation and the household.

title: High-Throughput Determination of Amino Acid Coupling in Protein Domains
gloss: Computational protein biochemistry project that analyzes high-throughput protein stability data to detect allostery, measuring thermodynamic coupling between distant amino acid residues within protein domains and using molecular modeling to propose the mechanisms behind the allosteric interactions.

title: Role of L-2-HG in glioblastoma TMZ resistance
gloss: Cancer biology research on chemotherapy resistance in glioblastoma, a deadly brain tumor, examining how the oncometabolite L-2-hydroxyglutarate affects the epigenetic enzyme TET2 and cancer stemness proteins in brain tumor cell lines, with the aim of informing new treatments.

title: The Role of Cyclical Voluntary Exercise and Amount of Exercise on 5xFAD Mice
gloss: Studies whether timed, cyclical voluntary exercise can reduce memory loss in a mouse model of Alzheimer's disease by working with the circadian rhythm, using activity monitoring and cognitive testing to explore nondrug treatment options for dementia.

title: Stress, microbiota, and infant health
gloss: Studies how maternal psychosocial and socioeconomic stress relates to the diversity and composition of infants' gut microbiota and to infant health, using longitudinal survey data and microbiome sequencing from mothers and infants in Cebu, Philippines.

title: The Evolution of Perceived Risk Among Medical Professionals and The Public in the UK (1993 - present)
gloss: A history of medicine project tracing how physicians, midwives and the public in the US and UK perceived the risks of childbirth from 1993 to the present, using archival research to examine debates over medical interventions, cesarean rates, home birth and maternal mortality.

title: Radio Drama as a tool of Language revitalization in Rwanda
gloss: A study of Ikinamico, a long-running Kinyarwanda-language Rwandan radio drama, as a tool for language preservation, cultural memory and social education, examining its oral storytelling, proverbs, sound design and performance through episode analysis, production team interviews and audience engagement on social media.

title: Emotional Acceptance and Mixed Emotions in Late Adulthood Loss
gloss: A psychology study of emotion regulation in older adults, testing whether people who habitually accept their emotions show greater physiological calming (parasympathetic activation) when regulating emotions while watching film clips about loss, compared with detachment and positive reappraisal strategies.

title: Analyzing biogenic silica concentrations to reconstruct primary productivity in southern Greenland
gloss: Paleoclimate study of Arctic lake sediment cores from southern Greenland, using biogenic silica as a proxy for diatom primary productivity over the Holocene to compare the effects of regional temperature change versus lake level and stratification changes.

title: Personality, Leadership, and Socioeconomic Status
gloss: A psychology study of how personality traits relate to leadership among college students in entrepreneurial programs, using personality assessments to predict how many leadership roles students hold in student organizations and comparing transformational and transactional leadership traits.

title: Narrative Identity Development in Older Adults' Perceptions of Aging
gloss: A psychology study of how older adults perceive their own aging, using life story interviews to examine narrative identity themes and how they differ by gender, race, and age, alongside well-being and physical health measures.

title: Watching a Disease: How Popular Narrative Media Has Taught Audiences About the Covid-19 Pandemic
gloss: A content analysis of how popular TV shows and films portrayed the COVID-19 pandemic and educated audiences about it, comparing observational and didactic learning, health topics, and tone. Examines narrative entertainment media as a tool for public health education and health communication.

title: Motion Sickness Research in the Lee Lab
gloss: Neuroscience research in mice on the brain pathway behind motion sickness and nausea, searching for signaling molecules released into cerebrospinal fluid that activate nausea neurons in the brainstem's dorsal vagal complex, using dissected and cultured neurons to build a screening assay.

title: Differential Roles of D1- and D2-Spiny Projection Neurons in Behaviors Associated With the Different Classes of Schizophrenia Symptoms
gloss: Neuroscience study in mice of how dopamine D1- and D2-receptor striatal neurons contribute to behaviors linked to schizophrenia's positive, negative and cognitive symptoms, using a model of excess striatal dopamine and chemogenetic neuron manipulation to seek better antipsychotic treatment strategies.

title: Physician Assisted Death: An Applied Bioethical Analysis
gloss: A philosophy thesis in bioethics on physician-assisted death, proposing a theory of what makes suffering intolerable and applying it to how physicians should evaluate assisted-death requests, especially for psychiatric illness under Canada's proposed law.

title: Investigating mechanism and dosing of BACE1 inhibitors for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease
gloss: Alzheimer's disease drug research testing how different doses of BACE1 inhibitors affect amyloid plaque buildup, neuroinflammation, and memory and behavior in a mouse model, to understand why these drugs cause cognitive side effects.

title: The Impact of Vested Interest on Source Expertise
gloss: A psychology experiment on misinformation and corrections, testing how a source's expertise and vested interest affect whether people believe retractions of false causes (the continued influence effect). Online participants read several news-style reports, extending earlier vested interest findings on source credibility across multiple stories.

title: Genetic Mechanisms Underlying Temperature Preference Adaptation in Drosophila melanogaster from Africa and Europe
gloss: Studies how temperature preference evolved in fruit flies (Drosophila melanogaster) as they spread from Africa to Europe, using behavioral thermal choice tests and genetic mapping in recombinant inbred lines to find the genetic basis of behavioral adaptation to new climates.

title: Designing and Implementing a Filtering Circuit for a Single Positron in a Penning Trap
gloss: Experimental particle physics project developing methods to trap and detect positrons in a Penning trap, including a dynamic electrical catching system and a more sensitive single-particle detection circuit, toward measuring the positron magnetic moment to test matter-antimatter symmetry and the Standard Model.

title: An Exploration of Women's Reactions to Body Positive Affirmations
gloss: A psychology survey study of how young women react to different types of body positive affirmations and messages, and how those reactions relate to body size, body dissatisfaction, thin-ideal internalization, and attitudes toward fatness and fat acceptance.

title: Investigating the Moderators of Digital Assistant Approval
gloss: A social psychology study of how people perceive emotionally intelligent, empathetic AI chatbots and virtual assistants compared with emotionally neutral ones, and how parasocial relationships, loneliness and familiarity with AI shape their approval of these assistants.

title: Determining Best Practices for Maintaining Successful Mutual Aid Organization in North Jersey and NYC
gloss: A qualitative study of how mutual aid groups that formed during the COVID-19 pandemic in northern New Jersey and New York City sustain themselves over time, using interviews and focus groups with organizers to identify practices, especially community engagement, that support group longevity.

title: The Latin Mass: Tradition, Family Values and Politics in American Catholicism
gloss: A mixed-methods study of a traditionalist Latin Mass Catholic community in Chicago, using surveys, interviews and ethnographic observation to examine parishioners' religious beliefs, political views and family values within the divide between traditionalist and mainstream American Catholicism.

title: STEM Education In Rwanda
gloss: A qualitative study of Rwanda's reformed math curriculum and STEM education policy, based on interviews with teachers, principals and policy figures, examining how educators adapt to new teaching methods, effects on student engagement and performance, and challenges facing under-resourced schools.

title: STAT3-JAK2 Function in PCAETCL
gloss: Cancer biology research on a rare, aggressive skin T-cell lymphoma (PCAETCL), testing which domains of the STAT3 protein in a STAT3-JAK2 gene fusion drive cancer cell growth, using molecular cloning to delete domains and growth assays in a cytokine-dependent cell line.

title: Crystalline Polyrotaxanes
gloss: Synthesizes polyrotaxanes, mechanically interlocked molecules with rings threaded on polymer chains, using artificial molecular pumps to find the upper limit of rings that can be threaded and to test whether these charge-dense molecules can be crystallized. A supramolecular and organic chemistry project.

title: Depiction of Pediatric Multiple Sclerosis in Film and TV Without Ableism
gloss: A creative writing project developing a TV pilot about two 12-year-olds living with multiple sclerosis, aiming to portray childhood chronic illness and disability without ableist tropes. Informed by analysis of illness portrayals in film and TV and interviews with young people with MS, families, advocates and physicians.

title: Identifying local causes of bird-window collisions through mapping
gloss: Maps bird-window collisions on the Northwestern campus using community collision-monitoring data and campus landscape data to find collision hotspots and test whether nearby green space, vegetation and trees relate to where birds strike buildings, informing efforts to reduce collisions and protect migratory birds.

title: Understanding the Effects of Hypoxia and Irradiation on Glioblastoma Stem Cells
gloss: Studies how the brain tumor microenvironment, specifically low oxygen (hypoxia) and tumor-associated macrophages, enriches glioblastoma stem cells and pushes cells into a quiescent state that helps them resist radiation therapy, using patient-derived cells, brain organoids and cell cycle analysis.

title: Single-atom Alloy Nanoparticles as Plasmonic Photocatalysts for Carbon Monoxide Oxidation
gloss: Synthesizes and characterizes dilute alloy nanoparticles that combine plasmonic metals (silver, gold) with small amounts of platinum on silica supports, and tests them as light-driven catalysts for carbon monoxide oxidation, aiming to replace fossil-fuel-powered thermal catalysis with visible-light photocatalysis.

title: Phenotyping mutant strains of C. elegans for benzimidazole resistance
gloss: Studies the genetics of anthelmintic drug resistance in the nematode C. elegans, using CRISPR-Cas9 knockouts of beta-tubulin genes to test which mutant strains resist benzimidazole drugs used against parasitic worm infections in humans and livestock.

title: Mental Health Narratives of First-Generation College Students (FGCS)
gloss: An anthropology study using ethnographic interviews to explore how first-generation college students talk about mental health, wellness, and distress, and how being first-gen shapes their identity and help-seeking at a university.

title: Innate Immune Mechanisms of Red Blood Cell Alloimmunization
gloss: Immunology research in mice on how the innate immune system drives antibody responses against transfused red blood cells, a complication of blood transfusion. It examines how stored blood activates dendritic cells through Toll-like receptor signaling and the MyD88 pathway.

title: Eye Regeneration Genes in Hofstenia miamia
gloss: Studies which genes drive eye regeneration in the worm Hofstenia miamia, a model organism for whole-body regeneration, using gene expression staining, RNA interference knockdowns, and a light-response behavioral assay to identify genes needed to regrow functional eye cells.

title: Investigating the Role of YbgF in GABA Export in B. subtilis Biofilms
gloss: A bacterial genetics project searching for the protein that exports GABA, a chemical signal, from Bacillus subtilis biofilms. It uses a knockout screen with a fluorescent reporter and metabolite analysis, and identifies the gene ybgF as a candidate exporter involved in biofilm communication.

title: The Role of Insight in Mathematical Thinking
gloss: A cognitive psychology study of insight, or sudden 'aha' moments, during mathematical problem-solving. Undergraduates solved math problems on tablets and marked when insights occurred, testing how insight relates to solving success and confidence in creative problem-solving.

title: Investigating synergistic effects of IKVAV PA and FGF-2 PA in human spinal cord organoid injury model
gloss: Tests bioactive peptide amphiphile nanofibers combining FGF-2 and laminin-derived IKVAV signals as a regenerative therapy for spinal cord injury, using injured human spinal cord organoids to assess biocompatibility and neuronal regeneration in a human tissue model.

title: The Evolution of the Perception of Risk of Childbirth in the US Among Physicians and Public (1993-present)
gloss: A history of medicine project tracing how physicians, midwives and the public in the US and UK have perceived the risks of childbirth since 1993, using archival research on maternal mortality, birth interventions such as cesarean sections and induction, home birth activism and women's autonomy in labor.

title: Particulate Organic Carbon Sources in the Allerton Park, IL Floodplains
gloss: Studies how much organic carbon is buried and stored in river floodplain sediments in agricultural Illinois, and where it comes from, using carbon concentrations and isotopes to assess how human-accelerated soil erosion since European settlement affects floodplain carbon sequestration and the carbon cycle.

title: The Impact Targeting Valency of SNAs has on Brain Delivery of Glucosylceramidase
gloss: Designs protein spherical nucleic acid nanoparticles that carry the enzyme glucosylceramidase across the blood-brain barrier as an enzyme replacement therapy for Parkinson's disease, comparing transferrin- and folate-targeted versions for uptake and enzyme activity in brain barrier cells.

title: Using Thallium Efflux to Conduct Fluorescence Activated Cell Sorting and Deep Mutational Scanning to Efficiently Catalog gain-of-function KCNT1 Variants.
gloss: Develops and validates a high-throughput thallium efflux fluorescence assay to identify gain-of-function variants of KCNT1, a sodium-activated potassium channel linked to a severe genetic epilepsy, aiming to screen variant libraries and guide precision therapies.

title: Non-Traditional Recumbent Tricycle Steering
gloss: Develops and tests a sensor-based steering system for recumbent tricycles to make them accessible to people with limited upper body mobility, comparing input devices such as touch sensors and joysticks. An assistive technology and adaptive recreation project combining mechanical engineering and computer science.

title: Improving First-Year Student Access and Engagement with Academic Resources in the McCormick School of Engineering & Applied Sciences
gloss: Interview-based education research on how first-year engineering students find and use academic support resources, examining barriers such as hustle culture and busyness, to inform the design of a tool that helps students locate resources.

title: Investigating the Correlation between Social Media Asociality and Negative symptoms in Clinically High Risk Populations
gloss: Studies how social withdrawal on social media relates to negative symptoms and everyday functioning in young people at clinical high risk for psychosis, comparing online and in-person asociality using clinical interviews and finding that passive social media use is linked to greater symptom severity.

title: Impact of relationship gratitude and self-esteem on perceived stress levels and relationship satisfaction in low-income couples facing unemployment
gloss: A psychology survey study of low-income cohabiting couples facing unemployment, examining how relationship gratitude, self-esteem, social support, and coping styles relate to relationship satisfaction, stress, anxiety, and depression over time.

title: Analysis of C-Fos Expression in 5xFAD Mice Post LPS Treatment
gloss: Studies how systemic inflammation affects brain activity in Alzheimer's disease mouse models, as a way to understand delirium. Uses c-Fos immunohistochemistry to map neuronal activity across brain regions in amyloid and tau transgenic mice after lipopolysaccharide injection, along with home-cage behavior tracking.

title: Effect of Disruption in Routine During the Pandemic on Employees' Psychological Outcomes
gloss: An organizational psychology survey study of why employees prefer remote work after the COVID-19 pandemic, examining how routine disruption and perceived organizational support relate to personal growth and work-style preferences, with implications for return-to-office decisions.

title: Exploring the Interaction of Self-Concept Clarity and Advice Seeking in Decision-Making
gloss: A social psychology study of how self-concept clarity, or how clear and consistent people's beliefs about themselves are, relates to advice seeking, decision difficulty and regret in hard personal decisions, using a survey and an experiment with a hypothetical job relocation choice.

title: Evaluation of calcitriol and calcifediol in nanoparticle-delivered therapeutics
gloss: Develops a mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) method to measure how much of the anti-inflammatory vitamin D drugs calcitriol and calcifediol is loaded into drug-delivery nanoparticles and taken up by cells and mouse skin, aiming to improve skin wound healing treatments.

title: Sex Differences in the Effects of Neurotensin on Decision-Making In Mice
gloss: Neuroscience study of how a neurotensin brain pathway from the thalamus to the amygdala shapes reward-seeking decisions under risk of punishment in mice, using optogenetics and operant conditioning to compare effects in males and females.

title: Positron Accumulation for a Standard Model Matter-Antimatter Asymmetry Test
gloss: Experimental particle physics project developing methods to trap and accumulate positrons from a radioactive source, including an electrical catching technique and a more sensitive single-particle detection method, toward measuring the positron magnetic moment and comparing it with the electron's to test matter-antimatter symmetry in the Standard Model.

title: Synthesis and Modulation of a Double Network Hydrogel via Cell-Free Expression of APOL3
gloss: Bioengineering project building a stimulus-responsive double network hydrogel, using cell-free protein expression inside the gel to produce the protein APOL3, which releases crosslinking molecules that change the gel's material properties. Aimed at modular smart materials for drug delivery, soft robotics and tissue engineering.

title: Researching Transnational Student Activism, China 1989 - US 2024
gloss: An original musical and theatrical work about transnational student activism, linking China's 1989 Democracy Movement and Tiananmen protests to present-day student activism in the US through the story of a Chinese American student activist and her father, a 1989 protester.

title: Modeling and Balance of Signed Directed Social Network
gloss: Network science study of structural balance in signed, directed social networks, where people link as friends or enemies, such as players in an online video game. It proposes new definitions of balanced triangles as an alternative to status theory and tests them against randomized versions of real network datasets.

title: Analysis of Reactive Oxygen Production in the Spinal Cord Organoid Injury Model
gloss: Studies oxidative stress after spinal cord injury using a human spinal cord organoid model, tracking how reactive oxygen species spread and cause secondary damage over time, and tests whether a novel biomaterial polymer reduces this damage as a potential regenerative medicine therapy.

title: Self-Assembling DNA Dendrons as a Novel cGAS-STING Immunotherapy
gloss: Designs and synthesizes branched DNA nanostructures (DNA dendrimers) as cancer immunotherapies that activate the cGAS-STING immune pathway to inflame immunosuppressive tumors. The project improves the chemical synthesis yield of these DNA structures and tests how DNA length and branching affect immune activation in cells.

title: Applicant Perceptions: Exploring the Roles of Race, Gender, and Perceived Femininity in Job Applicant Evaluations
gloss: A social psychology study of hiring discrimination, testing how race, gender, and feminine or gender-neutral personality descriptions shape evaluations of job applicants for teaching and technical roles. Two experiments simulate hiring decisions to examine stereotypes and perceived fit with an occupation.

title: Compulsory Heterosexuality and Queer Potential: Comparing Literature Aimed at Girls Aged 8-13 from 1868-2001
gloss: A literary study of popular novels for preteen girls from 1868 to 2001, using queer, feminist and narrative theory to argue that girls' literature engages with queerness and resists compulsory heterosexuality, focusing on protagonists who write and on female friendships.

title: Autonomy in Space Teams
gloss: Studies how increased crew autonomy on long-duration space missions affects team dynamics and the relationship between astronaut crews and mission control, using survey data and debrief interviews from NASA's HERA isolation and confinement analog to examine how team cohesion and conflict develop.

title: Unraveling the Dynamics of Glioblastoma Recurrence: Investigating Quiescent States, Stem Cell Behavior, and the Tumor Microenvironment
gloss: Cancer biology research on how the brain tumor glioblastoma resists radiation therapy and recurs, studying how tumor-associated macrophages and low-oxygen (hypoxic) conditions in the tumor microenvironment enrich cancer stem cells and push tumor cells into a quiescent, dormant cell cycle state.

title: Investigating the Role of Endoplasmic Reticulum Autophagy and Proteostasis in Parkinson's Disease
gloss: Studies how alpha-synuclein buildup in Parkinson's disease patient-derived neurons impairs the cell's response to misfolded protein stress in the endoplasmic reticulum, using RNA sequencing to examine the unfolded protein response and ER protein degradation pathways (ERAD and ER-phagy).

title: Donor Sperm Recipients' Perceptions of the Heritability of Race, Ethnicity, and Ancestry
gloss: A sociology study using interviews with donor sperm recipients to examine how they use donor race, ethnicity, and ancestry information when choosing a sperm donor, including beliefs about physical resemblance, shared culture, and forming family kinship bonds.

title: Case Studies of Best Practices in Thai and US Gender-Affirming Care
gloss: Qualitative case studies of transgender health clinics in Thailand and the US, using interviews, observation and patient materials to examine gender-affirming care beyond hormones and surgery, such as community-based research, clinician training, patient education and social and financial support services that improve access.

title: Person perception of ethnic-racial ingroups with the reverse correlation technique
gloss: A social psychology study of how East Asian and White people perceive who counts as East Asian, comparing in-group and out-group views and the role of ethnic-racial identity, using a reverse correlation face task, trait and behavior ratings, and open-ended survey questions.

title: Friendship Jealousy: An Exploration into the Impact of Attachments Styles on Friendship-Guarding Behaviors
gloss: A psychology survey experiment on friendship jealousy in young adults, the fear of being replaced by a third party in a close friendship. It examines how attachment styles relate to emotional reactions and protective behaviors such as rumination, withdrawal, and creating distance in adult friendships.

title: Reward Prediction Error Model and Flow States: How does challenge and immersion in a perceptual-motor skill learning task increase subjective reward
gloss: A psychology study of whether flow states during perceptual-motor skill learning are driven by reward prediction error, testing if succeeding at a harder version of a video-game-like sequence learning task makes practice feel more rewarding and immersive, with implications for motivation in education and sports.

title: The Effect of Leadership Behaviors and Technology Use on the Perception of Team Outcomes During the COVID- 19 Pandemic
gloss: A survey study of how leadership behaviors and the use of communication technologies such as email, phone, video and messaging affect perceptions of team performance and viability in remote work during the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: Exploring Physiological Linkages and Empathic Accuracy in Parent-Adolescent Conflict Conversations: A Study on Emotion Regulation and Relationship Dynamics
gloss: Psychology study of empathy in parent-teen relationships, testing whether heart-rate synchrony between caregivers and youth during conflict conversations predicts how accurately caregivers read their child's emotions, comparing families of youth at clinical high risk for psychosis with healthy control families.

title: Better Understanding Preschool Disciplinary Practices in the 21st Century: Drawing on the Voices of Early Childhood Educators
gloss: Interview study of preschool teachers and administrators on disciplinary and behavior management practices in early childhood education, comparing subsidized low-income and non-subsidized preschools and documenting a shift from harsh discipline toward positive, social-emotional approaches.

title: Determinants of Employment Rates by Sex and Education Across U.S. States, 1992-2019
gloss: An economics study of how employment rates for different sex and education groups respond to the business cycle, using U.S. state-level labor market data from 1992-2019. It examines unequal job losses during downturns, relevant to concerns about a K-shaped recovery from COVID-19.

title: Modeling gene expression epistasis in a complex network to understand emergent behaviors
gloss: A computational systems biology project studying gene expression epistasis, or nonadditive interactions between combined perturbations, in E. coli. It builds networks from public sequencing (RNA-seq) metadata and uses vector geometry to analyze how transcriptional responses to gene perturbations, drug treatments and growth conditions combine.

title: Child and Parent Communication in Overcoming Challenges During a Robot Coding Activity
gloss: A qualitative study of how parents help their children work through coding challenges while playing with codable robot toys at home, examining family communication and informal learning strategies like using body movement and household objects to support children's early computer programming.

title: Medical Mergers: Exploring Impact on Quality and Concentration in Medicaid Managed Care Markets
gloss: A health economics study of how corporate mergers and acquisitions among Medicaid managed care insurers affect market concentration and health plan quality, using state plan-level enrollment and quality data and a difference-in-differences analysis of consolidation's effects on lower-income patients.

title: Social Contagion of Knowledge: Do People Reproduce Others' Incorrect Answers?
gloss: A cognitive psychology experiment on social contagion of knowledge: whether hearing a partner give incorrect answers to general knowledge questions leads people to repeat those false answers. Relevant to misinformation, collaborative memory, and how false information changes what people believe is true.

title: The Flexibility of Implicit Perceptual Motor Sequence Learning
gloss: Cognitive psychology experiments on implicit learning, testing whether motor sequence skills learned without conscious awareness transfer to new contexts. Using a sequence learning task, the studies compare how changes to perceptual features versus motor responses affect expression of the learned skill.

title: Black-Owned Small Businesses in Englewood, Chicago: Documenting the Effects of COVID-19 and the Black Lives Matter Movement in 2020
gloss: Mixed-methods study of how the COVID-19 pandemic and 2020 Black Lives Matter protests affected Black-owned small businesses in Englewood, Chicago, using cell-phone foot traffic data and interviews with business owners to examine racial economic disparities, policing, and pandemic relief and policy support.

title: Emotions in Friendship and Mental Health
gloss: A psychology study of adolescent and young adult friendships, examining how positive and negative emotions friends experience during conflict and pleasant conversations relate to symptoms of anxiety and depression.

title: Machine Learning to Identify Cells in Zebrafish-Skin Patterns
gloss: Uses machine learning image analysis to identify and measure black pigment cells in microscope images of zebrafish skin stripe patterns, studying how pigment cell size varies across the skin and how training data affects cell detection.

title: Improved Methods for Image Classification with Auxiliary-Classifier GANs
gloss: Develops a modified auxiliary-classifier generative adversarial network (AC-GAN) for image classification with limited training data, comparing it against standard CNNs and AC-GANs on multiple datasets. A machine learning and deep learning project with applications to medical diagnostics and autonomous vehicles.

title: Symbolic Exchanges in Portuguese
gloss: A linguistics study of identity negotiation in intercultural conversations, analyzing recorded Zoom exchanges between Northwestern Portuguese language learners and native-speaking Brazilian college students during COVID-19, focusing on topic flow, word choice, tone and the shifting roles of native speakers and learners.

title: The Impact of Unemployment, Income, and Cash Transfer Payments on Suicide: Evidence from the U.S. and Alaska, 1976-2019
gloss: An economics study of how unemployment, income, and cash transfer payments affect suicide rates, using U.S. state-level data and Alaska Permanent Fund dividends to ask whether a universal basic income could reduce suicide and improve mental health.

title: "'Nasty Names:' Black Adolescent Discussions of Sexuality
gloss: A qualitative psychology study of how Black high school students talk about sexuality when describing their racial and gender identities, using thematic analysis of interviews to see whether their views uphold or resist homophobia, heteronormativity and racialized gender stereotypes, with implications for mental health care for Black queer youth.

title: Homeless Menstruation: A Construction of Embodied Experiences and a Breakdown of Amplified Psychosocial Issues
gloss: A library-research study of how menstrual stigma and homelessness stigma combine to worsen psychosocial and structural problems for people who menstruate while homeless, drawing on theories of embodiment, objectification, and capitalist and political structures to inform social change.

title: The Impact of Framing on Decision-Making in the Context of COVID-19
gloss: A behavioral economics survey experiment on how framing public health messages about COVID-19 infection risk affects people's risky decision-making, comparing positive, negative and household-exposure framings of willingness to go out to dinner during the pandemic.

title: Comparison of Approaches for Estimating Regional Hemodynamic Timing Differences in BOLD-fMRI data
gloss: Compares methods for estimating regional hemodynamic lag (blood flow timing delays) in resting-state BOLD-fMRI brain scans with breathing tasks, so that timing differences can be accounted for and functional connectivity maps of how brain regions communicate become more accurate.

title: Ankle Movement Indicators for Cerebral Palsy Diagnosis
gloss: Analyzes video-coded movements of young infants with and without cerebral palsy to see whether ankle movement patterns, such as the frequency and duration of pointed-foot positions, could serve as early indicators for diagnosing cerebral palsy and enable earlier intervention.

title: Visualizing a Fractal Representation of the British Coastline
gloss: A mathematics and computational mapping project on the coastline paradox, writing code to replace Great Britain's coastline coordinates with fractal segments and visualizing the resulting fractal coastline in ArcGIS to compare it with the real coast.

title: Effects of Activity on Diet-Induced Memory Improvements
gloss: A mouse study of how physical activity level affects spatial memory, using a low-activity genetic strain and a diet that increases activity, with attention to sex differences. It relates to exercise, cognition and Alzheimer's disease research.

title: Effect of Economic Conditions, Alcohol Consumption, and Vehicle Miles Travelled on Motor Vehicle Fatalities
gloss: An economics study of how economic conditions affect motor vehicle traffic deaths, testing whether driving (vehicle miles travelled) and alcohol consumption are the pathways linking the economy to fatalities, and comparing effects across sex and age groups.

title: Complex Timestepping for Numerical Methods
gloss: Applied mathematics research on numerical methods for solving differential equations using complex-valued timesteps, showing how simple schemes like Euler's method can reach higher-order accuracy, testing them on linear and nonlinear equations, and generalizing them through an optimization routine.

title: Side-by-Side Coaching: Integrating Three Planes of Teacher Learning
gloss: A qualitative study of side-by-side coaching for elementary school math teachers, using a sociocultural model of teacher learning to analyze coaching videos and how school context, professional development and relationships shape what teachers learn and adopt in practice.

title: How Do Different Household Definitions Affect Survey Data? Results from Global Dataset
gloss: Examines how the way surveys define a household, such as people who eat together, live together or share a budget, changes reported household composition and demographics, using household roster data from 57 surveys in 21 countries. Relevant to survey methodology, development economics and gender in welfare analysis.

title: Rapid and Robust Pipeline for Bacterial Organelle Assembly Analysis
gloss: An automated Python image-analysis tool that counts bacterial cells and the protein-based microcompartments inside them from fluorescence microscopy images, replacing manual counting. It supports research on disrupting microcompartment formation in disease-causing bacteria.

title: An Investigation of Infant Neuromotor Development through Proximal and Distal Arm Joint Movements
gloss: Studies infant neuromotor development and early detection of cerebral palsy by coding smartphone videos of premature infants' spontaneous arm movements, comparing shoulder versus forearm and wrist joint movements in infants with cerebral palsy and typically developing infants.

title: Deliberate Evaluation Reduces Reproductions of False Infomation
gloss: A cognitive psychology experiment on misinformation, testing whether asking people to judge the accuracy of true and false statements when they first read them, rather than how interesting they are, reduces how often they later repeat false information when answering questions.

title: Frequency of Isolated Finger Movement as a Predictor of Cerebral Palsy in Infants 12-14 Weeks (Corrected Age)
gloss: Studies whether how often young infants move individual fingers can serve as an early predictor of cerebral palsy, by coding parent-submitted videos of spontaneous infant movement and comparing babies later diagnosed with and without the disorder.

title: The Nonlocal Superconducting Quantum Interference Device
gloss: Physics project designing a new superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) magnetometer using superconductor/normal-metal/superconductor Josephson junctions that can measure magnetic flux without a voltage bias, avoiding microwave emission. Studied with superconductivity theory simulations and electronic transport measurements on a mesoscopic device.

title: Method for Calibration of Micron-Scale Distances Between Conducting Force Carriers
gloss: An experimental physics method that uses electrical capacitance to measure the micron-scale gap between two conducting surfaces, calibrating separation distance for short-range force experiments such as testing Newtonian gravity at micron scales and searching for new physics.

title: Information and Social Media: When and Why People Like and Share Accurate and/or False Claims
gloss: A psychology study of misinformation on social media, examining when and why people like and share posts containing accurate versus false claims, using participants' own explanations of their engagement decisions.

title: The Role of Circadian Timing of Sugar Consumption and of Exercise in Regulation of Healthy Body Weight
gloss: Mouse study of how circadian timing of eating and exercise affects obesity and weight gain, testing sugar-sweetened beverage intake during rest versus active phases and whether a prebiotic fiber supplement shifts physical activity toward the active period.

title: "Zooming Through the College Experience: How Emerging Adults Approach the COVID19 World"
gloss: A qualitative psychology study using interviews and a survey to explore how Northwestern college students, as emerging adults, experienced the COVID-19 pandemic, including changes in academics, peer relationships, family responsibilities and stress, with implications for student mental health support.

title: The Romanticization of Intimate Violence: A Case Study on Gossip Girl
gloss: A media studies analysis of how a popular teen TV show, Gossip Girl, romanticizes sexual violence, relationship abuse and stalking, using qualitative coding of every episode to identify themes such as victim-blaming, slut-shaming and minimizing violence in media aimed at adolescents.

title: Identification of Novel lncRNAs Nr2f2 and Ebf3
gloss: Molecular biology project characterizing two long non-coding RNAs, Nr2f2 and Ebf3, that form nuclear RNA clouds like the lncRNA Evf2, and examining their colocalization with cohesin, chromatin remodelers and transcription factors involved in gene regulation and embryonic development.

title: Optimizing the Conjugation of ACU-193 Functionalized Nanoparticles and Investigating its Ability to Detect Aβ Oligomers
gloss: Improving how efficiently Alzheimer's-targeting antibodies attach to magnetic nanoparticles designed to detect toxic amyloid-beta oligomers, aiming at MRI diagnostics and therapies for Alzheimer's disease. The work refines the nanoparticle functionalization protocol to reduce antibody waste while preserving specific binding.

title: Validating Genetic Tools to Isolate Individual ipRGC Subtypes: An Illumination Across Reporter Lines
gloss: Validates a genetically engineered mouse line designed to isolate individual subtypes of light-sensitive retinal ganglion cells (ipRGCs), using reporter lines, retinal dissection, immunohistochemistry and cell imaging. The work supports visual neuroscience research on how retinal cell types shape visual behavior.

title: Digitization of Mental Rotation and Shape Knowledge Assessments for Zoom
gloss: Adapting child psychology assessments of mental rotation and shape knowledge for online administration over Zoom with children ages 4-6 during the COVID-19 pandemic, and testing the reliability of remote developmental research methods.

title: Whitewashed: The Impact of Whiteness in Mississippi Landscapes
gloss: An art project using embroidered photographs and natural pigments to explore how whiteness and racism have shaped rural Mississippi landscapes, drawing on oral histories and archival records to prompt conversation about race in the rural South.

title: Imagining a Role Model: Female Children's Computer Science Self-Efficacy
gloss: A developmental psychology study of girls' confidence in computer science, examining whether girls who picture computer scientists as women have higher coding self-efficacy. Uses surveys and drawings to explore gender stereotypes about who belongs in STEM and computing.

title: Representations of Middle Eastern, Asian, and Indigenous Communities in Early American Mass Entertainment
gloss: A performance studies history of circuit chautauquas, the traveling tent shows of 1875-1935 America, examining how their lectures and entertainment shaped ideas of race and ethnicity and portrayed Middle Eastern, Asian, and Indigenous peoples as exotic and foreign, using archival research.

title: Public Health: The Impact of Superfund Sites on Cancer Rates in Pennsylvania
gloss: An environmental public health study of whether hazardous waste Superfund sites are associated with higher cancer incidence and death rates in Pennsylvania counties and cities, using regression analysis of state and CDC health data with demographic and unemployment controls.

title: Attributing Blame During the Coronavirus Pandemic
gloss: A qualitative interview study of how college students assign blame for the COVID-19 pandemic, examining how narratives of blame form and spread amid rising xenophobia, scapegoating of China, and declining social and institutional trust in the United States.

title: "Just because I don't act ladylike doesn't make me any less of a girl": Patriarchal Stifling of Self-Expression in Adolescent Girls
gloss: A qualitative psychology study of how Black, Latina and White adolescent girls talk about gender norms and expectations of femininity that restrict their self-expression, including constraints on appearance, voice and emotion, and how these differ by race.

title: Soil Quality as a Result of Anthropogenic Influences in Cedar Glade Habitats
gloss: Environmental science study of soil health in Middle Tennessee cedar glade habitats, comparing nutrient levels (nitrate, ammonium, phosphate), pH and dissolved solids in protected versus disturbed sites to assess how human activity and land protection affect soil quality and conservation of endangered native species.

title: The Threat of Vaccine Misinformation on Herd Immunity
gloss: An analysis of what drives parents' decisions to vaccinate their children, using CDC survey data to link parent, child and household demographics to childhood vaccination status. It examines vaccine hesitancy and anti-vaccination behavior and their implications for herd immunity and COVID-19 vaccination.

title: Asymmetrical Hip Flexion and Extension in Infants as a Predictor of Cerebral Palsy
gloss: Studies whether infant leg movements, specifically hip flexion and extension coded from videos of young infants, can serve as early indicators of cerebral palsy, comparing infants with and without CP to support earlier diagnosis of the developmental movement disorder.

title: On Grammatical Sensitivity
gloss: A psycholinguistics study testing whether native English speakers are sensitive to the grammatical structure of sentences while reading. It uses an online word-by-word reading-time experiment on how pronouns are interpreted in structurally different questions, and finds that readers do track sentence structure.

title: Efficacy of Rainfall Index Insurance as an Agricultural Risk Mitigation Tool: Evidence from Northern Ghana
gloss: Development economics study evaluating whether rainfall index insurance reduces weather-related crop loss risk for smallholder farmers in northern Ghana, using longitudinal farm data to estimate basis risk and assess how well insurance indices capture actual agricultural losses.

title: Developing MEK4 Inhibitors for Pancreatic Cancer Therapeutics
gloss: Medicinal chemistry project synthesizing small-molecule inhibitors of the kinase MEK4, an enzyme in the MAPK signaling pathway, as potential pancreatic cancer drugs, and testing their activity with an in vitro enzyme assay measuring ATP consumption.

title: How Northwestern University Students Determine Acceptable Speech
