gloss: Hearing science study comparing two methods of recording otoacoustic emissions, sounds produced by the inner ear in response to paired tones, as a way to assess inner ear function and detect early hearing loss in human participants.

title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics of DNA Metabolism-related Genes in Therapy-Resistant Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM)
gloss: Cancer biology research on why glioblastoma, an aggressive brain tumor, resists temozolomide chemotherapy. Uses immunofluorescence imaging of patient-derived tumor cells to locate DNA damage response and DNA repair proteins, including RRM2, ATM/ATR and Chk1/Chk2, after drug treatment.

title: Effects of Oligosaccharyltransferase (OST) inhibitors on Osteosarcoma Cell Lines
gloss: Cancer drug research testing new analogs of the glycosylation inhibitor NGI-1 on osteosarcoma (bone cancer) cell lines, using cell viability and clonogenic assays to see whether blocking N-linked glycosylation by oligosaccharyltransferase causes ER stress and kills cancer cells.

title: The Relationship between Mood and Engagement with Nature
gloss: A national survey study of how mood relates to time spent in nature and the barriers people of diverse identities face in accessing nature, exploring whether low mood itself keeps people from engaging with the outdoors and what this means for supporting mental health.

title: Are People "Real" on BeReal? Perception & Authenticity in Utilization of Social Media App
gloss: A psychology survey study of how U.S. college students use and perceive the social media app BeReal, comparing users and non-users on anxiety, fear of missing out, self-consciousness and authenticity, and examining whether the app delivers on its promise of authentic social connection.

title: Employment Sensitivity to Business Cycles within the Restaurant Industry - The PostPandemic Shift
gloss: An economics study of how employment in the US restaurant industry and the broader accommodation and food services sector responds to business cycles, using state-level labor data from 2003-2022 to examine part-time work, hours worked, and how the COVID-19 pandemic changed this sensitivity.

title: An Investigation of the Intersection of Race and Mental Illness Stigma
gloss: A social psychology experiment on whether stigma toward people with mental illness, specifically schizophrenia and depression, differs by race, comparing public attitudes toward Black and White individuals described in online vignettes.

title: Undergraduate Students and Autoimmune Disease: Integrating Qualitative and Quantitative Methods
gloss: A mixed-methods psychology study of how autoimmune diseases affect undergraduate college students, combining interviews with survey scales on illness intrusiveness, illness identity and perceived social support to examine coping, disclosure and the role of social support among young adults with chronic illness.

title: 12-Month-Old Infants Look Longer at Surprising Outcomes in a Two-Dimensional Change Violation Task
gloss: A developmental psychology study of infant cognition testing whether 12-month-old babies form object representations robust enough to notice when one toy animal is swapped for another, using looking-time measures in a video-based change violation task, with the aim of later examining how language shapes these expectations.

title: Quantifying the Softness of Wool via Structure/Property Relationships
gloss: Materials science study of what makes wool soft or scratchy, using electron microscopy and image analysis of fiber shape and surface roughness to link fiber structure to properties like friction, aiming toward objective lab tests of textile comfort instead of consumer touch studies.

title: Breaking Language Barriers: Surprising Similarities Between English and Mandarin Locative Constructions
gloss: A linguistics study comparing English and Mandarin Chinese syntax, using a sentence-naturalness survey of native Mandarin speakers to test whether Mandarin allows both word orders of locative constructions (spray paint onto the wall / spray the wall with paint) found in English.

title: D[if]f the Shoe Fits: When Can Children Recognize Same and Different Relations?
gloss: A developmental psychology study of when young children can recognize same and different relations, testing 4.5-year-olds on a relational match-to-sample task without training or feedback to understand the development of relational reasoning and analogy skills.

title: Analyzing Black Representation in Media
gloss: Qualitative media studies research on how streaming services promote Black films and TV shows, coding trailers for portrayals of Black joy versus Black trauma to assess racial diversity, stereotyping, and the authenticity of Black representation in American media.

title: Sadness and Anger in Relationship Conflicts and Links with Empathic Accuracy
gloss: Psychology study of how sadness and anger during marital conflict relate to empathic accuracy, the ability to correctly perceive a partner's emotions. Uses lab-recorded conflict conversations between married couples and dyadic statistical modeling to examine emotion and empathy in close relationships.

title: The Effect of the COVID-19 Pandemic on the Thailand Transgender Surgery Industry
gloss: Examines how the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted medical tourism for transgender surgery in Thailand, using clinic website archives, field photographs and a surgeon interview to show how clinics shifted from foreign patients to local Thai clientele.

title: The Effects of Spatial Smoothing on Identifying Selective Regions of the Prefrontal Cortex
gloss: A neuroimaging methods study testing how the amount of spatial smoothing applied when preprocessing resting-state fMRI data affects the ability to map functional brain networks in the lateral prefrontal cortex, weighing noise reduction against the loss of small brain regions.

title: Motor Abnormality in Infancy and the Later Development of ADHD Symptoms
gloss: A developmental psychology study of whether motor delays and attention regulation problems in infancy predict ADHD symptoms in toddlers, using longitudinal data on children followed from 12 to 24 months to explore early identification of ADHD risk.

title: Analyzing Sexual Risk-taking among Asian American Youth
gloss: Public health research on the sexual health of Asian American lesbian, gay, and bisexual youth, analyzing national Youth Risk Behavior Survey data to compare condom use, substance use during sex, HIV testing, and age at first sex between sexual minority and sexual majority Asian adolescents.

title: Lighting the Way: Gold Nanoparticles for Sustainable Chemistry
gloss: Synthesis and characterization of gold nanoparticles decorated with catalytic metals such as palladium and platinum for light-driven (photocatalytic) chemistry, aiming to replace energy-intensive heat-driven reactions with sustainable processes using visible light.

title: Packing Edge-Colorings of Graphs
gloss: A graph theory project on packing edge-colorings, a type of edge-coloring that bridges proper and strong edge-colorings. It uses them to approach the Erdos-Nesetril conjecture on strong edge-colorings, presenting results for graphs with maximum degree at most four.

title: "That's Me on the iPad!": Online Individual Music Instruction for Students with Disabilities in a Community Music Program
gloss: An ethnographic study of how moving online during the COVID-19 pandemic affected a student-run community music program offering individual lessons to young people with disabilities, examining accessibility, disabling barriers, and relationships among volunteers, parents, and students in virtual music education.

title: Post-synthetic Modification of SIFSIX-3-Ni with n-Octylphosphonic Acid for Enhanced Hydrophobicity and Water Stability
gloss: Chemistry research on making a metal-organic framework (MOF) used for carbon dioxide capture more water-resistant, by chemically attaching phosphonic acid to its surface so it stays stable and hydrophobic in humid conditions while still adsorbing CO2 for industrial carbon capture.

title: Restoration of Cellular Adhesions in Darier's Disease
gloss: Lab study of Darier's Disease, a rare genetic skin disorder in which calcium dysregulation from reduced SERCA2b protein weakens cell-to-cell adhesion, testing whether drugs that activate SERCA2 in heart and muscle can restore skin cell adhesions as a potential treatment.

title: Cognitive Performance of Patients with WHO Grade III IDH Wild-Type Glioma vs Patients with WHO Grade III IDH Mutant Type Glioma
gloss: Neuropsychology study comparing cognitive performance in brain tumor (glioma) patients across tumor grades, focusing on whether IDH gene mutation status in grade III gliomas relates to cognitive test scores, with implications for prognosis and treatment planning.

title: The Progression of Stressful Expression: The Relationship Between Age, Stress, and Social Anxiety
gloss: A psychology study of how age, life stress, and social anxiety relate to one another, comparing the types of life stressors reported by adolescents and adults with varying levels of social anxiety.

title: Understanding Endometriosis Pain Communication Through Provider Perspectives
gloss: A qualitative health communication study using interviews with primary care providers to examine how they talk with patients about endometriosis and its pain, including pain assessment, pain management recommendations, and providers' confidence and knowledge gaps in delivering care.

title: Disparities in Incidence and Outcomes of Pediatric Esophageal Atresia and Tracheoesophageal Fistula
gloss: A study of racial disparities in the incidence and surgical outcomes of esophageal atresia and tracheoesophageal fistula, congenital defects in newborns, using a national pediatric hospital database. It compares mortality, hospital stay and complications across races and between open and minimally invasive thoracoscopic surgery.

title: Assessing Limitations of Using Propidium Monoazide to Determine Viable Cells in Microbial Samples
gloss: A microbiology lab study testing how storage temperature and wait time before propidium monoazide (PMA) dye treatment affect measurement of viable bacterial cells, using DNA extraction and qPCR on Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Relevant to methods for detecting live pathogens on surfaces for infection prevention.

title: Social Determinants of Health in Community-Dwelling Dementia Patients Aged 65 and Over: Analysis of the 2019 National Health Interview Survey
gloss: A public health study using national survey data to examine how social determinants of health, such as economic stability, education, healthcare access, neighborhood and social context, relate to dementia among older adults living in the community in the United States.

title: Efficacy of Emotional Regulation Strategies in the Classroom
gloss: A psychology survey study of whether emotional regulation strategies, cognitive reappraisal and mindfulness, help college students manage stress, stay focused and stay motivated while studying, conducted during the COVID-19 pandemic and analyzed through qualitative coding of student responses.

title: Community-Academic Initiative to Measure and Improve Underrepresented Group Participation in Parkinson's Disease Research
gloss: Community outreach study on racial and ethnic diversity in Parkinson's disease clinical trials, using educational workshops and surveys in Chicago neighborhoods to measure underrepresented groups' knowledge of Parkinson's, trust in medical researchers, and willingness to join research.

title: How Perception of Hearing Difficulties Changes with Age
gloss: A longitudinal audiology study of how adults' self-perceived hearing difficulties change with age, testing whether self-assessment questionnaires capture hearing decline over about ten years. Relevant to age-related hearing loss and hearing aid recommendations.

title: Assessments for Identifying Tactile Deficits at the Upper Extremity of Individuals with Stroke: Preliminary Results of a Scoping Review
gloss: A scoping review of how touch and sensory deficits in the arm and hand are assessed after stroke, comparing behavioral tests and neuroimaging methods and identifying gaps such as testing only at rest rather than during active movement.

title: Gentrification and Gente-Displacement: Community Changes in Small Cities
gloss: A literature review on how gentrification affects Latine communities in small U.S. cities, focusing on Ecuadorian residents of Sleepy Hollow, New York, and how displacement and a changing sense of place disrupt their social ties and community building.

title: Low Reward-Related Brain Function is Uniquely Associated with the Construct of Narrow Depression
gloss: An fMRI study of how depression and anxiety symptoms in at-risk adolescents relate to reward-related brain activity, linking specific depression symptoms to reduced ventral striatum activation and shared distress symptoms to cortical activation during a monetary reward task.

title: Race Conversations: Exploring Whether and How Black and White Parents Talk with Their Children about George Floyd
gloss: A developmental psychology survey study of whether and how Black and white parents talked with their elementary-age children about George Floyd's murder and racism after summer 2020, including parents' reasons for avoiding these race conversations.

title: The Holocaust as an Interpretive Framework: American Jewish Interactions with Contemporary Social Injustice
gloss: A qualitative study of how American Jewish individuals and organizations invoke or reject comparisons between the Holocaust and contemporary political issues and social injustice, such as immigration detention, the death penalty, abortion, the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and COVID-19 protests, and what this means for Jewish identity and activism.

title: Colloidal Synthesis and Ferrofluids
gloss: Chemistry and materials science research on synthesizing colloidal particles, including hematite cubes and charged polystyrene spheres, as building blocks for shape-controlled magnetic particles, with applications such as drug delivery and custom inks. It studies how synthesis conditions affect particle size and makes stretched, anisotropic particles, characterized with SEM imaging.

title: Identifying Factors that Impact the Retention of Racial Minorities in Pre-Medicine
gloss: A psychology survey study of what predicts whether Black, Hispanic, and Indigenous pre-medical students at predominantly white institutions plan to attend medical school, looking at belonging, course difficulty, course demands, and racial microaggressions, in the context of racial diversity among physicians.

title: Promoting Operating Room Sustainability Through a Novel Seal Design For Laproscopic Trocars
gloss: Design of a reusable, flexible seal cap for reusable laparoscopic surgical trocars that fits different-sized instruments while holding gas pressure, aimed at reducing single-use medical device waste and improving operating room sustainability.

title: Environmental (In)justice in Chicago: Racial and Socioeconomic Disparities of Heavy Metal Contamination in Chicago
gloss: An environmental justice study measuring heavy metal contamination in Chicago soil samples and using GIS mapping to examine its correlation with racial and socioeconomic demographics across neighborhoods, linking pollution disparities to redlining and discriminatory zoning.

title: Development of an MR-Compatible System to Assess Force-Dependent Neural Activity
gloss: Development of a pneumatically actuated, MRI-compatible device that applies constant grip-like forces to the fingertip, used with fMRI brain imaging to study how the brain processes touch and force perception, with future applications to populations such as stroke survivors.

title: Parasitic Bacteria and Their Effect on Carbon Capture by Biofuel-Relevant Microalgae
gloss: Microbial ecology study of whether mutualistic bacteria can protect biofuel-relevant microalgae from a parasitic bacterium that kills algae and crashes cultivation ponds, using co-culture growth experiments, DNA sequencing of bacterial communities and microscopy to improve algal cultivation for renewable bioenergy.

title: Using Sounds Generated by the Ear to Diagnose Ear Problems
gloss: Hearing science and audiology research evaluating a new clinical test that uses sounds emitted by the inner ear (distortion product otoacoustic emissions) to detect hearing loss across the full cochlea, comparing its diagnostic accuracy against the current standard protocol in normal and impaired ears.

title: Partlence (Documentary)
gloss: An archival documentary film about the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan, using survivors' oral histories with personal and archival footage to portray the violence, trauma, and forced migration of the Partition and the breakdown of communal harmony between religious groups.

title: Wingman (Short Film)
gloss: A short film about a young man who feels isolated and betrayed when his friend pursues the girl he likes, using non-linear, parallel storytelling from thrillers combined with romantic comedy elements to blur fantasy and reality and explore relationships, emotions and the human psyche.

title: Confidentiality Antonym (Poetry)
gloss: A creative writing poetry collection voicing things the author could only write, not say aloud, including poems on toxic coaching and mistreatment of athletes and on sexual assault told through the Greek myth of Daphne and Apollo.

title: The Failures of Global Health Imagery: The Continuation of Colonialism in Global Health
gloss: A critical analysis of how global health organizations such as the Gates Foundation and Partners In Health portray Global South communities in their imagery, arguing that these visuals reflect ongoing colonialism and white savior narratives in global health and humanitarian work.

title: Designing a Novel Interactive RC Airplane Testbed for Aerospace Engineering Education
gloss: Design of a low-cost remote-controlled airplane testbed with interchangeable wings and in-flight data measurement, built for hands-on aerospace engineering education in high school. The engineering design project used CAD, computational fluid dynamics and finite element analysis to let students test how wing design affects aerodynamic performance.

title: Towards Digitization: Humboldt Park and the PRCC's Community Archive
gloss: Community archiving work with the Puerto Rican Cultural Center in Chicago's Humboldt Park, laying groundwork for digitizing records of the city's Puerto Rican community through literature review, a survey of local community archives, and web design strategies for accessible digital archives amid gentrification.

title: Teacher Learning Communities: Its Impacts on Equitable Education
gloss: Studies teacher professional development and teacher learning communities in a university-school district research partnership, aiming to promote educational equity for lower-income students and students of color. Includes qualitative coding of teacher feedback and co-designing a middle school future-selves intervention with teachers.

title: Musculoskeletal Modeling of Locomotor Muscle Synergies in People Post-stroke
gloss: Uses personalized musculoskeletal models and predictive gait simulations to study how patterns of one-sided muscle weakness after stroke (hemiparesis) affect walking, explaining why stroke survivors show different step length and step timing asymmetries.

title: The Acculturative Foodways and Gut Microbiomes of Korean Americans in the New York Metropolitan Area
gloss: A mixed-methods anthropology study of how Korean immigrants in the New York area balance dietary acculturation and preserving Korean food traditions, using surveys, interviews, and gut microbiome analysis to link diet and grocery access to microbial diversity and immigrant health.

title: All or Nothing: Exploring Asymmetric Information and Resource Sustainability
gloss: A thesis using an experimental resource allocation game to study how asymmetric information affects cooperation, collusion and free-riding in shared common-pool resource use, with implications for sustainability and collective action.

title: Fostering AI Literacy Amongst Middle Schoolers through Unplugged Activities
gloss: Designs unplugged, low-tech paper-based activities that teach AI literacy to middle school students through embodied interaction and personal identity. The activities are standalone lessons with instructions and learning objectives that humanities teachers can add to their curriculum.

title: Assessing Biocide Efficacy in Inhibiting Growth and Reducing Viability of Microorganisms in Biodiesel
gloss: Microbiology study testing how well a common biocide controls microbial contamination in biodiesel storage tanks, where fungi, yeasts and bacteria contribute to fuel degradation and microbially induced corrosion of steel.

title: Two Studies on Trait Mindfulness, Self-Compassion, and Affective Polarization
gloss: Two psychology survey studies examining whether trait mindfulness and self-compassion relate to affective polarization, comparing feelings thermometer, trust, and social-distance measures of attitudes toward the political out-party among Democrats and Republicans.

title: Nothing is Fiction, Everything is Reality: Perspectives on Demons and Spirits in Tibetan Buddhism
gloss: An interview-based study of how monastics and laypeople in Nepal understand demons and spirits in Tibetan Buddhism. It covers their philosophical nature, their role in religious practice, the limits of translating the Tibetan term as "demon," and what these ideas reveal about differences between Tibetan and Western thought.

title: The Effects of Overconfidence on Academic Achievement
gloss: A psychology study of overconfidence in college students, examining what shapes students' confidence in their abilities and how confidence relates to academic performance, using an online trivia survey that varied question difficulty and whether participants knew how others scored.

title: Optimizing Transepidermal Water Loss Collection and Molecular Analysis for Early Non-Invasive Skin Disease Detection
gloss: Development of a wearable silicone device that collects water evaporating through the skin and analyzes its ions and amino acids, aiming at non-invasive early detection of dry-skin diseases such as eczema (atopic dermatitis), psoriasis and xerosis.

title: Help Employees to Help Businesses
gloss: A literature review of how employee benefits such as paid family leave, contraceptive coverage and comprehensive healthcare affect corporate talent recruitment, productivity and profits, turned into one-page advocacy briefs that help HR staff make the business case for better workplace benefits.

title: The Effects of Membrane Fluidity on Membrane Protein Folding
gloss: Bacterial cell membrane biophysics research examining how membrane fluidity, controlled by unsaturated fatty acid content in engineered E. coli, affects the folding of membrane proteins, measured with fluorescent protein tags, microscopy and flow cytometry, with the aim of informing antibacterial therapeutics.

title: Testing the Feasibility of Using Acoustic Sensors for Bubble Detection for the Scintillating Bubble Chamber Experiment
gloss: Experimental particle physics project testing whether piezoelectric acoustic sensors can replace cameras for detecting bubble formation in a dark matter detector, the Fermilab Scintillating Bubble Chamber, using a cryogenic pressure chamber of liquid CF4 and spectrogram analysis of acoustic signals.

title: Undocumented Status as a Legally Produced Vulnerability to U.S. Racial Capitalism
gloss: A theoretical study of how U.S. immigration law produces undocumented status as a form of structural vulnerability, arguing that this legal status serves racial capitalism by confining undocumented immigrants to low-wage work, poverty, and restricted movement and opportunity.

title: A Symphony of Binary Black Hole Collisions: Studying Cosmic Noon with Gravitational Wave Backgrounds
gloss: Gravitational wave astrophysics project that simulates the stochastic background from unresolved binary black hole mergers detected by LIGO and uses hierarchical Bayesian inference to infer where these mergers occur, probing Cosmic Noon, the era of peak star formation.

title: Favoritism, Stress, and Clout Chasing: Conservatory Experiences of Music Performance
gloss: An interview-based sociological study of how studying music performance at a conservatory (Northwestern's Bienen School of Music) affects students' identity, mental health and well-being, and social relationships, including competition, peer comparison, and doubts about pursuing music careers.

title: Rabbis and Rabble-'Rousers: A Comparative Analysis of Mid-to-Late-20th Century Jewish Activism in the US and South Africa
gloss: A comparative-historical study of Jewish involvement in social and political activism in the United States and South Africa during the mid-to-late 20th century, examining why Jews were initially overrepresented in both movements and why their involvement later diverged, using memoirs and surveys of Jewish organizations.

title: Design and synthesis of a nitrogen-free spin-correlated radical pair
gloss: Synthesizes an organic donor-bridge-acceptor molecule that forms a light-generated spin-correlated radical pair without nitrogen atoms, aiming to sharpen EPR spectra for molecular quantum bits. The charge separation and recombination dynamics are characterized with transient absorption spectroscopy for quantum information science.

title: Understanding the Role of Interpersonal mindfulness and Other Foundations of Healing in a Traditional Chinese Medicine encounter: A Qualitative Study
gloss: A qualitative interview study of US Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioners exploring how interpersonal mindfulness, trust, and the therapeutic relationship shape the practitioner-patient encounter and healing, with attention to health equity, quality of life, and integrative or complementary medicine.

title: The Impacts of Teacher Turnover: A Comparative Study of Public and Charter Schools in Illinois
gloss: An economics study of how teacher turnover affects student outcomes such as test scores and dropout rates, comparing public and charter schools in Illinois and differences across racial groups, using Illinois State Board of Education panel data.

title: Sound Science: Investigating DPOAE Methodologies for Hearing Diagnostics
gloss: An audiology study comparing two methods of recording distortion product otoacoustic emissions (DPOAEs), an objective test of inner ear (cochlear) health, in normal-hearing adults to assess their usefulness for diagnosing hearing loss in research and clinical settings.

title: The role of praise on children's exploratory behaviors during spatial activities.
gloss: Developmental psychology study of how parents' praise relates to children's exploration and problem-solving as parents and children program a robot together, examining praise type and quantity alongside coding attempts, spatial talk, and children's confidence and attitudes toward coding.

title: Investigating Mechanisms of Radioresistance in TYK2 Knockout Head and Neck Cancer Cells
gloss: Cancer biology research on why head and neck squamous cell carcinoma cells lacking the TYK2 gene resist radiation therapy, testing whether the knockout alters cell signaling, cell cycle arrest, or genomic instability using Western blots, flow cytometry and micronuclei staining.

title: Developing Spherical Nucleic Acids as a Brain Cancer Therapeutic
gloss: Designs and tests liposomal spherical nucleic acid nanoparticles as an immunotherapy for glioblastoma brain cancer, studying how their DNA structure affects activation of the cGAS-STING immune pathway in cell assays.

title: Myoelectrical Estimation of the Ankle Joint Torque in Real-Time
gloss: Decodes motor unit firing (neural drive) from high-density EMG of ankle muscles with a CNN to predict ankle joint torque in real time, comparing it to a conventional EMG method, toward more intuitive control of rehabilitation exoskeletons.

title: Complicating Cottagecore: Nostalgia, Imagination, and the Eighteenth Century
gloss: An art history thesis on the cottagecore aesthetic as nostalgic self-expression, tracing its roots in eighteenth-century European pastoral art and ways of seeing, and examining how its historical references carry ideas about race, gender, sexuality, beauty and whiteness into internet fashion and subculture.

title: Plastic Recycling with Bacteria at Scale: Dicarboxylic Acid Tolerance of Comamonas testosteroni KF-1
gloss: Studies biological plastic recycling by testing how well the sewage sludge bacterium Comamonas testosteroni KF-1 grows on plastic-derived dicarboxylic acids at high concentrations, assessing microbial tolerance and metabolic limits for scaling up bacterial recycling as an alternative to mechanical plastic recycling.

title: Motivations for Becoming Mothers or Remaining Childless: A Comparative Study of Black Mothers and Non-Mothers in Chicago
gloss: A sociology interview study of how Black women in Chicago view the U.S. healthcare system and how those perceptions, along with other social factors, shape their decisions to become mothers or remain childless.

title: Levetiracetam Decreases Amyloid-beta Production in Alzheimer's Disease
gloss: Neuroscience research in Alzheimer's disease mouse models testing how the epilepsy drug levetiracetam reduces amyloid-beta production, using isotope labeling, mass spectrometry and neuron surface-protein labeling to show it shifts amyloid precursor protein to the cell membrane, pointing toward a possible new Alzheimer's treatment.

title: Visualizing Warehouse Locations in CONUS to See Idling Effects from Heavy Duty Vechiles
gloss: Maps warehouse locations across the contiguous United States to estimate air pollution from idling heavy-duty diesel trucks, an emission source missing from EPA models. Uses GIS and supercomputing to build a spatial emissions surrogate and examines environmental justice impacts on low-income and minority neighborhoods.

title: Autonomic Activity During Bladder Distension Task Predicts Development of Menstrual Pain
gloss: A prospective study of whether autonomic nervous system activity, measured by heart rate variability during a bladder filling task in adolescents before their first period, predicts later development of menstrual pain (dysmenorrhea). It examines visceral sensitivity and sympathetic and parasympathetic balance as causes of painful periods.

title: Following or Blocked: College Students' Perspectives and Utilization of Sexual Health Information Present on Social Media
gloss: A sociology interview study of how college students use and feel about sexual health information on social media, and whether their social networks or their general approach to social media shape that use.

title: Mapping water insecurity interventions to promote climate-resilient communities in Chicago
gloss: A meta-analysis of research on water insecurity in Chicago, including contamination, cost and aging infrastructure, that ranks possible interventions by scale and political feasibility to build a roadmap for equitable, climate-resilient water governance, with attention to impacts on communities of color.

title: Virtual reality training for improving older adults' long-term memory
gloss: A study of whether a virtual reality spatial navigation game can improve long-term memory in healthy older adults, comparing VR headset versus tablet play, the wayfinding game versus a VR control game, and testing whether cognitive training can be done at home instead of in the lab.

title: Mechanisms of Steroid Receptor Coactivator Recruitment
gloss: Structural biology study of how the Parkinson's disease drug target Nurr1, a transcription factor, binds its coactivator SRC1, using bacterially expressed proteins and solution NMR spectroscopy to map protein-protein interactions in gene regulation and inform new therapies.

title: Recombinant Production of Cyanophycin in E. Coli
gloss: Engineering E. coli to produce cyanophycin, a nitrogen storage polymer, as a lower-energy alternative to the Haber process for capturing nitrogen from wastewater. The project tests growth conditions and works on improving the solubility of the cyanophycin synthetase enzyme to boost production.

title: Examining the Relationship between U.S. and Chinese-led Development Aid Commitments and International Political Alignment in Cameroon
gloss: A political science study of how U.S. and Chinese development aid to Cameroon relates to Cameroon's international political alignment with each country, using regression analysis to examine foreign aid as a tool of geopolitical influence in Africa.

title: Effects of Medicaid Coverage of GLP-1 Agonist Drugs on Measures of Racial Disparities
gloss: Health economics study using a microsimulation model to project how Medicaid coverage of GLP-1 agonist drugs for diabetes and obesity would affect long-term healthcare spending, chronic disease prevalence, and racial disparities in health among low-income populations.

title: Balancing Act: Exploring the Influence of the Federal Work-Study Program's Impact on College Student Identity, Experience, and Self-Perception
gloss: An interview study of how Northwestern students in the Federal Work-Study program experience campus jobs, examining how financial-need-based work affects their identity, sense of belonging, community, academic life, and perceptions of the program's costs and benefits.

title: Processing-Structure Relationships in Battery Coatings
gloss: Studies how coating process conditions in battery manufacturing, such as dispense rate, sheet speed and dispenser distance, affect the microstructure and alignment of thin-film electrode coatings, with the goal of lowering costs for grid-scale energy storage batteries.

title: Characterizing variability in responses to acute intermittent hypoxia (AIH) using blood oxygen saturation time-series
gloss: Analyzes blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) data from a clinical trial to measure how much hypoxic dose varies within and between people receiving acute intermittent hypoxia, a low-oxygen therapy, to help standardize dosing and keep participants safe.

title: Tinkering here to there: Parent-child interactions and spatial conversation in home and museum settings
gloss: A developmental psychology study comparing how parents and children collaborate and talk about spatial concepts during a hands-on tinkering activity at home versus in a museum, with implications for informal STEM learning and children's spatial skills.

title: Synthesis and analysis of layered SiO2/TiO2 photocatalysts for hydrogen fuel release from common organic molecules
gloss: Chemical engineering research on making and testing layered silica-titania (SiO2/TiO2) photocatalysts that use sunlight to release hydrogen fuel from liquid organic hydrogen carriers, comparing atomic layer deposition and chemical liquid deposition methods for clean energy storage and transport.

title: Racial Disparities in San Francisco Arrest Dispositions
gloss: Analyzes racial disparities in how San Francisco police arrests lead to filed cases, convictions and dismissals for Asian, Black and White people, using police data to support challenges to systemic bias in the criminal legal system under California's Racial Justice Act.

title: Examining the Nesting Microclimate of Olive Ridley Sea Turtles
gloss: Field study of how air temperature and rainfall affect sand temperatures inside Olive Ridley sea turtle nests during incubation on Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula, with implications for temperature-dependent sex determination and climate change risk to nesting beaches.

title: Disrupting Antibiotic Resistance: Harnessing Cobalt Schiff base complexes' Inhibitory Effects on NDM-1 to Restore Antibiotic Efficacy
gloss: Tests cobalt(III) Schiff base metal complexes as inhibitors of the bacterial enzyme NDM-1, a metallo-beta-lactamase that breaks down penicillin-type antibiotics, aiming to overcome antibiotic resistance and restore antibiotic effectiveness through enzyme inhibition assays and structure-activity insights for new drug design.

title: Irrational Beliefs: Cognitive Failure or a Rational Way of Navigating an Irrational World?
gloss: A psychology experiment testing whether feeling uncertain, rather than poor probabilistic reasoning, drives belief in the paranormal, superstition and conspiracy theories, and how anxiety and the need for control shape those irrational beliefs.

title: Social Influences on Coffee Consumption
gloss: An economics study of how social groups and peer norms shape consumer behavior, using a survey of Northwestern undergraduates to examine how majors, demographics and student clubs influence how often students visit Starbucks and other coffee shops.

title: Subsquares in random Latin squares and rectangles
gloss: A combinatorics and probability project proving results about random Latin squares and Latin rectangles, showing that a uniformly random Latin square almost surely has no large Latin subsquares, making progress on an open conjecture from 1999.

title: Assessment of phage susceptibility of CHG-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa from hospital ICUs
gloss: Microbiology study of antimicrobial resistance in hospital ICUs, testing bacteria from hospital surfaces for tolerance to the disinfectant chlorhexidine and examining whether resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa can be killed by bacteriophages, as a step toward evaluating phage therapy and identifying bacterial phage defense systems.

title: Constructing the Autistic-Transgender Intersection: A Critical Discourse Analysis
gloss: A sociology study using critical discourse analysis to examine how scientific claims linking autism and transgender identity are constructed and used across clinical research, gender-affirming medicine, media, state policy, activism, and lived experience, and how these discourses shape recognition of autistic trans people.

title: Encoding within an Abstract Dimension of the Hippocampus using a Mouse Model
gloss: Neuroscience study of whether the mouse hippocampus encodes abstract hierarchies, such as numerical value relationships, in a way similar to place cells mapping space. Mice learned a visual task choosing symbols with higher assigned values, setting up calcium imaging and optogenetics of hippocampal neurons.

title: Single Shot Reinforcement Learning in Robotic Hardware
gloss: Designs and builds robotic hardware to test single-shot reinforcement learning, where a robot learns a task from a single example instead of large training datasets. The project implements maximum diffusion reinforcement learning on a physical robot and explores its applications.

title: Greening Pilsen: Mapping Native Plant Species for Equitable Biodiversity and Green Spaces
gloss: A GIS mapping project identifying which native plant species suit sites in Chicago's Pilsen neighborhood, supporting a community group's greening efforts to increase urban biodiversity and address environmental justice gaps in green space access.

title: The Role of Light in Sleep Health and Sleep Disparities
gloss: Studies how nighttime light exposure relates to sleep health, such as sleep duration and fragmentation, and whether it helps explain racial disparities in sleep between Black and White adults, using wrist monitors and bedroom light sensors from a large real-world cohort study.

title: Investigating N-Movement in English: Presence and Proposals
gloss: A syntax study of whether nouns move within English noun phrases, using a new coordination construction and an acceptability rating experiment to test head movement and island constraints, and asking where the moved noun lands.

title: LGBTQIA+ Identity Exploration and Expression Through Self-Insert Fanfiction
gloss: An interview study of how LGBTQIA+ fans use self-insert fanfiction, stories in which readers and writers place themselves, to explore and express their gender and sexual identity, and how online fandom communities support queer identity development.

title: Understanding Pretest Perceptions and Concept Retention Factors to Enhance Industrial Engineering Program Assessment
gloss: An engineering education study of how Northwestern's industrial engineering department assesses student learning, using course pretest data and interviews with students and faculty to examine perceptions of pretests and what helps students retain concepts, to inform program assessment and pretest policy.

title: Cradle-to-Grave Life Cycle Assessment of Interventional Radiology MRI, Stereotactic, and Ultrasound Biopsy Kits
gloss: A life cycle assessment of the environmental impact of disposable medical supplies, measuring the carbon emissions and energy use of plastic image-guided breast biopsy kits used in hospitals, and weighing the recycling of healthcare plastic waste and the use of renewable materials.

title: Spectral Characteristics and Exciton Dynamics of Mixed-dimensional Organic/Inorganic Heterostructures
gloss: Studies the light emission, absorption and exciton dynamics of mixed-dimensional van der Waals heterostructures that combine 2D transition metal dichalcogenides with organic semiconductor molecules (vanadyl phthalocyanine), aiming to understand their interactions for optoelectronic devices.

title: Online Robotic Gait Learning using Generative AI
gloss: Develops a generative autoencoder method that lets a legged robot learn to walk online in unknown environments with unknown dynamics, combining active walking trials, a latent-space reward function and sparse-data training, tested in a simulated four-legged robot.

title: Kombilesa Palenque : African Legacy in Colombia
gloss: An ethnographic study of the Afro-Colombian Palenquero community in Barranquilla, Colombia, examining its history, endangered culture and language, urban migration, and activism. The findings are presented through an interactive map-style educational website with video interviews and photographs.

title: "Its charity shall be as broad and expansive as the firmament of Heaven": How Chicago's First Jewish Hospital Transcended the Demarcations of Faith
gloss: Archival history research on Chicago's first Jewish Hospital, opened in 1868, recovering its forgotten story, founders and doctors, and showing that Jewish medical philanthropy in early Chicago was a collaboration between Jews and non-Jews serving patients of all races and religions.

title: The Impact of Stressful Life Events on Psychopathology: A Comparative Study of Clinical High-Risk for Psychosis and Major Depressive Disorder
gloss: Compares how stressful and traumatic life events relate to psychotic-like symptoms such as hallucinations and delusions in people at clinical high risk for psychosis, people with major depressive disorder, and healthy controls. A clinical psychology study of trauma, life stress and mental illness.

title: "They made it feel like anything was possible": Exploring the Impacts of High School Mentorship on Black Adolescent Girls in Undergrad
gloss: A study of how high school mentorship affects the college experience and success of Black women undergraduates at elite, predominantly white universities, using surveys and interviews to examine belonging, identity development, and the role of mentors who share students' identities.

title: Jammin', Jazz, and Jawaiian: "Black Music in Hawai'i"
gloss: Archival research on the history of Black music in Hawai'i, tracing how jazz, reggae, hip hop and rap arrived on the islands and shaped Hawaiian culture, drawing on African American studies, musicology and Pacific Island studies to recover Black musicians' overlooked role in Hawaiian history.

title: Investigating Neural Modulation in Essential Tremor Through Peripheral Electrical Stimulation
gloss: Studies how peripheral electrical stimulation affects brain activity in patients with essential tremor, a neurological movement disorder, comparing open-loop and closed-loop stimulation using resting-state functional MRI to measure changes in brain connectivity linked to tremor control.

title: Investigating the Effects of Phoneme Sensitive Period Timing on Language Learning
gloss: Infant brain development study using EEG to track when the sensitive period for learning speech sounds begins, testing whether early general anesthesia shifts its timing and whether that timing predicts toddlers' later language skills.

title: Circumscribed Race, Space & Place: Transportation & Embodiment in Everyday Cuba
gloss: Qualitative research on how Afro-Cuban women experience race, gender and sexuality while moving through public space in Cuba, focusing on the hitchhiking practice en botella. Uses interviews and literature on racial geographies and gendered mobility to examine racism and misogyny in post-revolutionary Cuba.

title: Performance of Social LEAP Estimates Animal Poses (SLEAP) Improves with Visual Distinction Across Different Experimental Situations
gloss: Evaluates the SLEAP machine learning software for tracking poses of multiple mice in video of social interactions, testing whether one model works across different experimental setups and whether bleaching fur helps tell animals apart. Computer vision for automated animal behavior analysis in neuroscience.

title: The Effects of Social Support and Self-Awareness on the Career DecisionMaking Self-Efficacy of College Students
gloss: A psychology survey study of how support from parents, teachers and peers, along with self-awareness, shapes college students' confidence in making career decisions (career decision-making self-efficacy), including whether teacher and peer support change the effect of parent support.

title: Brokers in Migration from Ghana to Qatar
gloss: An ethnographic study of migration brokers who help Ghanaians migrate to Qatar for work, examining their services, strategies, motivations, and challenges, and what this means for labor migration governance between Ghana and Qatar.

title: Exploring Identity and Affiliation: A Comparative Analysis of Inclusion Among International Students in the U.S. Branch Campuses in Education City, Qatar
gloss: A mixed-methods sociology study of belonging and inclusion among international students at U.S. university branch campuses in Education City, Qatar, examining how non-citizens build identity and community without citizenship and how campuses adapt culturally and structurally to foster inclusion.

title: The Therapeutic Role of Annexin A6 in Alzheimer's Disease
gloss: Alzheimer's disease research in mice testing whether gene therapy delivering the membrane-repair protein Annexin A6 to adult brains can protect neurons from amyloid-induced damage, comparing viral delivery through the bloodstream with direct brain injection.

title: How does the human ovarian microenvironment change after exposure to alkylating chemotherapy?
gloss: Studies how alkylating chemotherapy affects blood vessel growth and maturity in human ovarian tissue, using stained cryopreserved biopsies from pediatric cancer patients. The work addresses fertility preservation and why transplanted ovarian tissue loses its egg-containing follicles in childhood cancer survivors.

title: Advancing Human Neuromuscular Junction Simulation with a Novel Soft Electronic Device
gloss: Develops soft, 3D microfabricated electronic devices that wrap around neuron and muscle organoids to record and stimulate electrical signals, sense muscle contraction, oxygen and temperature, with the goal of modeling a human neuromuscular junction on a chip for neurodegenerative disease and drug testing.

title: Identification of Type 4 Secretion System Substrates in S. maltophilia
gloss: Microbiology research on the multi-drug resistant pathogen Stenotrophomonas maltophilia, identifying which bacterial-killing effector proteins are substrates of its type 4 secretion system by testing their binding to the coupling protein VirD4 with a bacterial two-hybrid assay.

title: Adaptive Regression Trees: A Flexible Approach to Regression using Smooth functions and Decision Trees
gloss: A new machine learning regression method that combines decision trees with multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS) to model data with both smooth nonlinear trends and abrupt piecewise changes, compared against random forests and XGBoost, with a public software implementation.

title: The Propagation Puzzle: Unraveling Community Clusters in the Stochastic Block Model Network
gloss: A theoretical and simulation study of community detection in networks, analyzing how variants of the label propagation algorithm converge to consensus or separate clusters on the stochastic block model, with mathematical proofs about opinion spread in social networks.

title: Representation in Voting: The Intersection of Descriptive and Substantive Representation from the Experiences of Black and Latine Communities
gloss: Political science research on how Black and Latine voters in Chicago weigh shared identity versus policy issues when choosing elected representatives, using coded interview transcripts to study descriptive and substantive representation, voter trust, and race and ethnicity in electoral decisions.

title: How Often Do You Think About the Roman Empire? A Closer Look at the Lives of Romans We Should Think About More
gloss: A classics project reconstructing the lives of ordinary Romans, especially freedwomen, through a case study of an Early Imperial epitaph of a freedwoman hairdresser, using Latin inscriptions, epigraphic databases and archaeology to explore women's work, finances and social identity in ancient Rome.

title: JB13's Therapeutic Potential to Recover Plasticity and Normalize Brain Changes in Alzheimer's: Insights from ELISA Testing
gloss: Tests an experimental drug, JB13, as a potential Alzheimer's disease treatment, using ELISA protein assays in Alzheimer's mouse models to measure its effects on amyloid and tau protein buildup and on markers of synaptic plasticity linked to learning and memory.

title: Sustainable Recovery of Critical Metals using Manganese Oxide Adsorbents
gloss: Develops and tests a reusable manganese oxide nanomaterial adsorbent on a cellulose substrate for recovering critical metals like cobalt and nickel from waste streams such as recycled electronics, battery waste, mining sites and landfill runoff, supporting sustainable metal recycling.

title: Understanding Space Crew Interactions Through Modeling Dialogue as Networks
gloss: Studies teamwork and shared mental models among crews on long-duration space missions by applying machine-learning topic modeling to crew dialogue from podcast audio logs and mapping the conversations as semantic hypergraphs to track how shared understanding changes over time.

title: Investigating the validity of automated language sample analysis as a predictor of narrative ability in individuals with co-occurring autism spectrum disorder and impairments in expressive language
gloss: Tests whether automated computational language analysis software can measure storytelling (narrative) ability as well as manual hand coding in autistic individuals with limited expressive language and lower verbal IQ, using stories told from a wordless picture book.

title: The Music for Childhood Well-Being Initiative: A Group-Singing and Breathwork Intervention For Supporting Youth Well-Being Globally
gloss: A pilot study testing whether a group-singing and breathwork program can reduce stress and improve mental health and well-being in children aged 9-11 at sites in the US, England and Mexico, measured with heart rate sensors, anxiety and belonging surveys, and interviews.

title: Machine Learning for Quantum Sensor Data Analysis in Dark Matter Search
gloss: Uses neural networks to detect and locate charge jumps in superconducting qubit data, repurposing quantum computing qubits as sensors in the search for dark matter. Combines machine learning, quantum sensing and particle physics.

title: Learning to Allocate Fairly
gloss: Develops a reinforcement learning algorithm for fair resource allocation by nonprofits facing uncertain, sequentially arriving demand, such as food banks distributing food to pantries. Uses alpha-fairness to balance efficiency and fairness, evaluated with data from mobile food pantries.

title: Comparative Histological Analysis of the Ferret, Dog and Mouse Olfactory Systems
gloss: Compares the organization of the olfactory epithelium in the nose of ferrets, dogs and mice, using tissue staining and gene expression mapping to see how odorant receptor zones in carnivores' complex nasal cavities relate to those in rodents.

title: Beabadoobee and Artistic Expressions of Asian Identity
gloss: A media studies analysis of Filipino-British musician beabadoobee's songs, music videos and public persona, examining how an Asian immigrant artist expresses cultural identity and representation in the global music industry and how bedroom pop and new media spread diverse personal narratives to global audiences.

title: Ain't Afraid of No Ghosts: Network Analysis and Equity Impacts of CTA Bus Service Disruption During Pandemic
gloss: Transportation equity study of how COVID-19 service cuts to Chicago Transit Authority (CTA) bus routes affected different demographic and geographic groups, using GIS, network analysis, census data and ridership data from before, during and after the pandemic to inform urban planning and transit policy.

title: BDUs to Blazers: The Role of Identity and Interpersonal Relationships in the Transition to Civilian Life
gloss: An interview-based study of how military veterans, particularly combat veterans, transition to civilian life, examining how veteran identity, prior social identities and interpersonal relationships shape well-being after leaving service, with implications for community-based veteran support programs.

title: Analysis of Eye-Tracking Technology for Infant Cognition Research
gloss: Validates iCatcher+, an automated deep-learning tool for tracking where infants look, by comparing its results with manually coded video of infant gaze. The project aims to make eye-tracking for infant cognition and developmental psychology research cheaper and easier to scale.

title: Behind the Swipe: Examining Decision Patterns with Transgender Profiles in Mock Online Dating Simulation
gloss: A psychology study using a mock online dating simulation to examine how disclosing transgender identity in dating profiles affects swiping and attractiveness ratings, and how participants' gender identity and sexual orientation shape responses, reflecting cisgenderism and transphobia in online dating.

title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Jewish Environmental Education
gloss: Evaluates environmental and climate education resources available on free Jewish educator websites, assessing how easy they are to find and how well they meet criteria for effective environmental education, such as being nature-based, values-based, hopeful and actionable, in the context of religious education and Tikkun Olam.

title: Pandemic Impacts on Parent-Child Relationships
gloss: A developmental psychology study of how COVID-19 pandemic stress affected parenting and parent-child relationships, relating parents' reported stress and household changes to positive parenting behaviors coded from parent-child interaction videos, with interviews on pandemic stressors and benefits for families with young children.

title: Advancing ALS Research: Development and Analysis of a Novel Mouse Model for Studying TDP-43 Mislocalization
gloss: Neuroscience research developing a mouse model of ALS by inducing hemorrhagic (ICH) stroke and examining TDP-43 protein expression and localization in brain and spinal cord cells, linking stroke to TDP-43 pathology in neurodegenerative disease.

title: Design Optimization of Skin-Interfaced Humidity Sensors for Improved Stability and Accuracy in Skin Barrier Function Assessment
gloss: Redesigning a wearable skin humidity sensor that measures trans-epidermal water loss to assess skin barrier function and skin health. The project modifies the device's structure and aerodynamics to improve measurement stability and accuracy, validating it against commercial devices for dermatology uses such as monitoring atopic dermatitis.

title: Exploring Activities
gloss: An online developmental psychology study built on the Lookit platform that examines how 5-10 year old children's spatial abilities, measured through mental rotation, perspective-taking, and spatial anxiety tasks, relate to the activities and sports they participate in, motivated by links between spatial skill and STEM and math ability.

title: What Is the Right Way to Talk? Using Master Narratives to Analyze Singaporean Parents' Experiences Speaking Singlish
gloss: A qualitative interview study of how Singaporean parents experience speaking Singlish, an English-based creole, and talk about it with their children. It uses a master narrative framework to examine language stigma, legitimacy, identity and power related to race, education and belonging.

title: Grief Unmasked
gloss: An honors thesis art project that represents the stages of grief, adapted from the Kubler-Ross model and the author's personal loss, as wearable masquerade masks shown in a gallery. It draws on psychology, religion and art to explore mourning through masks as an embodied practice.

title: Increasing the adaptive potential of corals to a warmer ocean.
gloss: Studies how corals could better survive ocean warming and bleaching by examining epigenetic control of gene expression. Optimizes an electron microscopy technique (ChromEM) to image chromatin structure in coral cells and link it to heat tolerance.

title: Examining the association between traditional working memory performance versus motor-involved working memory tasks in people at clinical high-risk for psychosis
gloss: Compares working memory in people at clinical high risk for psychosis and healthy controls, using a traditional letter n-back task and a motor-dependent gesture memory task, to see whether motor dysfunction compounds working memory deficits and how differences vary with task difficulty.

title: SPORTSWASHING REVISITED: An analysis of international relations principles in the cases of Qatari and Saudi Arabian investment in sport
gloss: A thesis on sportswashing, how states use major sports investments to improve their global image despite human rights criticism, examining Qatar's 2022 FIFA World Cup and Saudi Arabia's sports spending through international relations concepts like soft power, propaganda, sports diplomacy and place branding.

title: MrgprD-Expressing Neurons and Mast Cells in Type-2 Diabetic Wound Healing
gloss: Studies how pain-sensing sensory neurons (Mrgprd-expressing) and mast cells interact to drive inflammation in poorly healing Type-2 diabetic wounds, using a mouse model in which these neurons are ablated. Examines neuro-immune communication in skin as a route toward treatments for diabetic wound healing.

title: Stress and Adolescent Identity Development
gloss: A developmental psychology study of how life stress relates to identity formation in adolescence, using regression analyses of cross-sectional and longitudinal data to test whether higher stress predicts greater identity confusion in teenagers.

title: Exploring the Impact of Dating App Usage on Mental Health in Adolescents: A Focus on Sexual and Gender Minority Youth
gloss: A psychology study of how dating app use relates to depression, suicidal ideation and risky behavior in adolescents, especially sexual and gender minority (LGBTQ) youth, tracking smartphone app usage over six months to weigh the mental health harms and benefits of online dating.

title: Bisexual individuals comfortability with straight and gay potential romantic partners
gloss: A psychology survey study of how comfortable bisexual people feel dating straight versus gay partners, examining bias against bisexuality in dating and romantic relationships, including comfort discussing their sexuality with a new partner.

title: Federal Legalization of Sports Betting, Five Years Later - A Dangerous Wager?
gloss: A legal and public health policy analysis of state-legalized online sports betting in the five years after the Supreme Court's Murphy v. NCAA decision, examining gambling addiction risks for young men, advertising and harm reduction, and Illinois sportsbook data, and arguing for federal regulation.

title: The Children's Depression Rating Scale (CDRS): Whether Subscales Track Nuances in Adolescent Depression
gloss: A psychometric study of a clinician-rated depression scale for adolescents, using factor analysis to identify symptom subscales and testing whether the measure works consistently over time, to better capture the varied ways depression presents in teens and inform personalized treatment.

title: Evaluating regenerative dressings in a clinically relevant model
gloss: Tests regenerative biomaterial wound dressings, a peptide-functionalized thermoresponsive polymer, for healing chronic diabetic foot ulcers in a diabetic pig model, comparing wound closure and tissue regeneration against a commercial dressing and saline.

title: Development of a Novel Mouse AMD Model to Study Immune Cell Role in the Disease
gloss: Develops a genetic mouse model for age-related macular degeneration (AMD) that selectively depletes immune cells, retinal microglia or choroidal macrophages, to study how these macrophage types contribute to the eye disease and vision loss.

title: Uncovering Oncogenic Driver Mutations in Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma
gloss: A cancer genomics project that pools publicly available mutation data from published Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma studies into one large dataset and uses mutation recurrence to identify candidate driver mutations in this white blood cell cancer, aiming to inform new or repurposed treatments.

title: Microscopic Espionage: Investigating the Role of Bacterial Defense Systems Towards Prediction of Successful Phage Therapy
gloss: Studies which genomic features of antibiotic-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa from pneumonia patients, such as bacterial defense systems and integrated phages, predict whether bacteriophage therapy will succeed, combining genome analysis with phage infection assays to support alternatives to antibiotics.

title: A Closer Look At Coral Bleaching
gloss: Optimizes methods for dissociating live coral tissue into viable cell suspensions, to support studies of how chromatin structure and epigenetics shape gene expression in heat-tolerant corals that survive climate-driven coral bleaching.

title: Me vs We: How Attachment Style Informs Optimal Distinctiveness in Relationships
gloss: A psychology study of romantic relationships examining whether attachment style (anxious or avoidant) shapes how much closeness versus independence people want from a partner, using optimal distinctiveness theory, and how the gap between desired and actual closeness relates to relationship quality, using a survey of adults.

title: Exploring Lewis Acidity and pH dependence of Zirconium/Hafnium-based MetalOrganic Frameworks for Enhanced Nerve Agent Hydrolysis
gloss: Chemistry research on using zirconium- and hafnium-based metal-organic frameworks (MOF-808) as catalysts to break down nerve agents, studying how pH and metal Lewis acidity affect hydrolysis rates of a nerve agent simulant, for chemical warfare defense.

title: Innovating Alone, Together: The Impact of Innovation Incubators on Female Founders
gloss: A qualitative interview study of how startup incubators and accelerators affect women entrepreneurs, including those with other underrepresented identities, looking at access to funding, networks, mentorship and affinity-based programming for student and alumni founders.

title: Examining the relation between infant irritability and language
gloss: A developmental psychology study of whether irritability in infants aged 12-18 months is related to their early communication skills, including spoken expressive language and gesture use, using observed parent-child interactions and parent reports from two cohorts.

title: Stop Selling College as a White Dream to Black Bodies
gloss: Qualitative interview study of how math and STEM identities develop among underrepresented young adults in Northwestern's Causeway post-baccalaureate math PhD bridge program, examining how social contexts like financial resources, health care, family and education shape personal identity and how educators can support marginalized students.

title: "What Makes Me an Ethnic-Racial In-group": Exploring the Content Underlying One's Ethnic-Racial Identity
gloss: A qualitative interview study of how East Asian undergraduate students understand the content of their ethnic-racial identity, including what criteria such as ancestry, appearance, culture and upbringing make someone a member of their ethnic-racial group.

title: Exploratory Machine Learning Analysis of the Determinants of Covid Cases, Mortality, and Implication for Effective Governance
gloss: Uses machine learning (LASSO regression and random forests) on cross-national data from 172 countries to identify which governance and societal factors predict COVID-19 infection and death rates, and draws policy recommendations for how governments can respond to pandemics and other public health crises.

title: Preparation and formulation of supramolecular calcitriol as wound-healing agents for skin and eyes
gloss: Synthesizes supramolecular forms of calcitriol, a vitamin D metabolite, attached to polymer and organic cores so the drug releases gradually, aiming to create a controlled-release eyedrop and skin treatment for wound healing and eye inflammation from chemical injury or dry eye.

title: Learning STEM From Analogies: Scaffolding as the Stepping Stone
gloss: A cognitive psychology experiment testing whether training undergraduates with scaffolding templates improves their ability to understand scientific analogies, by mapping object correspondences and shared relational structures, with the goal of improving STEM learning and education.

title: Synthesis and Analysis of Drug-loaded Microspheres with cannabinoids for potential use in Uterine Fibroid Embolisation
gloss: Biomedical engineering project making biodegradable polymer microspheres loaded with THC, a cannabinoid painkiller, for use in uterine fibroid embolization. The microspheres are made with microfluidics and tested for size and drug release, aiming to reduce post-procedure pain and opioid use.

title: Soft Stewart Platform: a Novel Device for Connecting Material Properties and Robot Learning
gloss: A soft robotics project that builds a Stewart platform driven by 3D printed compliant metamaterial actuators instead of rigid linear actuators, to study how actuator material properties affect robot learning, such as learning to balance a ball on the platform.

title: Hexagonal Boron Nitride Ionogels for Iontronics Applications
gloss: Develops mechanically stiff yet ionically conductive gels made from ionic liquids and two-dimensional hexagonal boron nitride nanomaterials, a nanocomposite materials research project aimed at iontronics and bioelectronics devices such as ionic diodes and printable electrolytes for transistors.

title: Analyzing the Perception of Public School Resource Officers on Social Media
gloss: Analyzes social media discourse on Instagram and X about police school resource officers in public schools, examining how public perceptions vary by race, gender and region, and proposing policy recommendations for school safety, policing in education and equity.

title: Advancing Scientific Replication with NexusGraph: A Novel NLP Approach
gloss: Develops NexusGraph, a natural language processing tool that extracts materials, reagents, equipment, suppliers and author metadata from scientific papers and generates step-by-step protocols to help replicate research methods, addressing the reproducibility crisis in biomedical and materials science research.

title: Impacts of Pandemic Instruction Mode on High School Students' Education Outcomes: Evidence from U.S. States
gloss: An education policy study of how remote, hybrid and in-person instruction during the COVID-19 pandemic affected high school students' test scores, achievement gaps and dropout rates, using state-level data from six U.S. states.

title: Swarm Robotics Simulator
gloss: A software simulation environment for testing and validating swarm robotics algorithms for a 100-robot swarm testbed without using physical robots, making multi-robot coordination research cheaper, lower-risk and more accessible.

title: The Effect of Platonic Relationship Breakups on Academic Performance
gloss: A psychology survey study of college students examining how ending a friendship (a platonic breakup) affects academic performance, stress and wellbeing, and what this means for student mental health, counseling and social support.

title: A Divergent Justice: A Comparative Analysis of Command Responsibility in the War Crimes Trials of Bosnia Herzegovina and Serbia
gloss: A comparative legal study of how domestic war crimes courts in Bosnia-Herzegovina and Serbia apply command responsibility, the international criminal law principle holding commanders liable for subordinates' crimes, after the Yugoslav tribunal closed. It examines transitional justice and accountability for higher-ranking officials.

title: Understanding Female Neurophysiology: How Force Steadiness Changes with the Menstrual Cycle and Oral Contraception
gloss: A thesis on female neurophysiology and motor control, studying how the menstrual cycle and oral contraceptive use affect force steadiness and motor unit firing during voluntary muscle contractions, and addressing the underrepresentation of women in neuromuscular research.

title: Camus: Optimizing Mouse Home Cage Behavior Monitoring Using Video
gloss: An open-source, low-cost video camera system for continuous monitoring of lab mouse behavior in standard home cages, tracking activity, circadian rhythms, feeding, drinking and nesting with pose estimation software, built to support research on neuropsychiatric disease mouse models.

title: More Than a Sore Throat: a Bilateral Peritonsillar Abscess Case Report
gloss: A medical case report of a rare bilateral peritonsillar abscess, a throat infection seen in the emergency room, with a literature review of its signs, diagnosis and treatment. It highlights point-of-care ultrasound and other imaging for diagnosis and offers tips for abscess drainage.

title: Posting Behind Bars: The Paradox of Prison TikTok
gloss: Studies how incarcerated and formerly incarcerated people in the U.S. use social media like TikTok and Instagram to manage criminal-record stigma, build community and critique prisons, while facing surveillance and public scrutiny. Uses content analysis of videos and comments plus interviews.

title: From the Ashes: A Cross-Cultural Comparative Study on Community Response to Fire Disaster in Australia, Greece, Portugal, Ghana, Argentina, and Brazil
gloss: A cross-cultural comparative study of how communities respond to wildfire disasters in six countries, using ethnographic fieldwork, interviews and policy analysis to examine gaps between fire management policy and local experience, Indigenous knowledge, and community-based disaster resilience under climate change.

title: Efferocytic Signaling Suppresses Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy
gloss: Immunology research in mouse models on chronic heart transplant rejection, examining how cleavage of the macrophage receptor MerTK, involved in clearing dead cells (efferocytosis), drives inflammation and cardiac allograft vasculopathy, and whether preventing it prolongs graft survival.

title: Forward Genetic Screen for a Putative GABA exporter in Bacillus subtilis
gloss: A bacterial genetics project screening gene knockouts in Bacillus subtilis to find a protein that exports GABA, a signaling molecule in biofilms, using a fluorescent reporter, time-lapse microscopy, and metabolite measurements to understand chemical signaling in bacterial communities.

title: Evaluation of the effects of curvature on kirigami structures
gloss: Studies how curvature affects kirigami (cut-paper) canopy structures for adaptive building facades, testing mechanical stability, shading and ventilation using centimeter-scale physical models with different cut patterns. Relates to climate-adaptive architecture and urban heat and air quality.

title: Patterns of X-linked Inheritance: A New Approach for the Genome Era
gloss: A review of X-linked genetic disorders arguing that the traditional dominant and recessive classification of X-linked inheritance is outdated, examining disease expression in females and X chromosome inactivation, and proposing a new four-group framework to improve genetic diagnosis, counseling and education.

title: Optimization of Mfp5 Production Through T3SS-Mediated Protein Secretion
gloss: A synthetic biology project engineering bacteria to secrete a protein-based adhesive biomaterial. It modifies the mussel foot protein Mfp5 and the Salmonella Type III secretion system to improve recombinant protein expression, secretion titer and efficiency, avoiding intracellular aggregation and difficult purification.

title: Beauty Work and Body Image: The Role of Appearance Investment, Body Surveillance, and Body Dissatisfaction
gloss: A psychology survey study of young U.S. women examining how investment in appearance relates to time spent on beauty work such as makeup, hair grooming, clothing choice, and appearance-focused dieting or exercise, and whether body surveillance, body dissatisfaction, and perfectionism shape that link to body image.

title: Enzyme-decorated Spiky Gold Nanoparticles in Drug Delivery Applications
gloss: Studies whether spiky gold nanoparticles, compared with spherical ones, better preserve the activity of enzymes attached to their surface for enzyme-based drug delivery and cancer therapy, using horseradish peroxidase as a model enzyme to test how nanoparticle shape affects enzyme stability and loading.

title: Conservation on a Slippery Slope: Mapping and Preventing Erosion in Manduriacu, Ecuador
gloss: Maps soil erosion risk in Ecuador's Manduriacu cloud forest using satellite imagery, GIS and the RUSLE model, validated with local rangers in the field, to show how deforestation and road building drive erosion and to guide reforestation and conservation priorities.

title: Understanding Human Decision Making: from Behavioral Economics to Artificial Intelligence
gloss: A mathematical study of the Drift Diffusion Model of human decision-making, using stochastic calculus and numerical experiments to compare model variants, reviewing its applications in medicine, economics and artificial intelligence, and proposing its use to study decisions and the value of information under bank run risk.

title: Sleep Wearables in Women's Health
gloss: A systematic review of wearable sleep-tracking devices in women's health, evaluating their accuracy, usability, and health impact across life stages such as menstruation, pregnancy, and menopause, and examining bias in the existing research on these devices.

title: Dual-Chronoamperometry Drift Correction for Electrochemical Sensors
gloss: Develops a dual-chronoamperometry method that corrects signal drift and biofouling in electrochemical biosensors by applying mirrored positive and negative potentials to extract faradaic current, aimed at reliable continuous point-of-care biomarker monitoring, demonstrated with interferon-gamma detection.

title: Nuclear Abolition Activism On Campus: Catalysts and Motivations for Action
gloss: A survey and interview study of why Generation Z college students at Northwestern rarely engage in nuclear disarmament activism, examining how identity, fear, political polarization, lack of knowledge, and a preference for identity-based activism shape youth political participation.

title: Modifying virus-like particles for improved cargo transport and assembly
gloss: Protein engineering of virus-like particles derived from the MS2 bacteriophage for drug delivery and targeted treatments. The project circularly permutes the viral coat protein to relocate its termini and tests how different versions assemble and package cargo.

title: Alzheimer's and Immunization: How Astrocytes Help Clear Amyloid-Beta in Treated Patients
gloss: Alzheimer's disease research on how astrocytes, brain support cells, help clear amyloid-beta after immunotherapy. Uses single-cell RNA sequencing and computational analysis of brain tissue from immunized and non-immunized patients to identify astrocyte subtypes and gene expression changes.

title: The delivery of nucleic acids for the systemic treatment of inflammations
gloss: Uses spherical nucleic acid nanoparticles to deliver an inhibitory DNA oligonucleotide (INH18) to cells as a potential treatment for chronic inflammatory diseases, an alternative to steroid drugs. Combines nanoparticle synthesis with cell studies of inflammation suppression.

title: The past is the key to the present: using 94-million-year-old rocks to understand modern ocean acidification
gloss: Geochemistry research using calcium isotope analysis of a rock core from West Texas to test whether a global ocean acidification event occurred during Oceanic Anoxic Event 2, a Cretaceous carbon cycle disruption, as an ancient analog for modern climate change and ocean acidification.

title: Potential drawbacks and/or benefits Mexican women experience embracing a positive beauty philosophy vs a neutral beauty philosophy
gloss: A psychology study of body image among Mexican college women, comparing body positivity and body neutrality through interviews and month-long journaling and affirmation interventions, and examining how culture, colorism, teasing and collectivist family dynamics shape how they see their bodies.

title: Addressing Eurocentricity in Western Musical Theatre Pedagogy
gloss: Research assistance on a book chapter examining racist and classist origins of terminology in musical theatre voice pedagogy, which favors European classical singing styles, and proposing more inclusive replacement terms for teaching singing in theatre.

title: Targeting the DNA Repair Protein HMCES in Cancer
gloss: Cancer genomics study of the DNA repair protein HMCES, using The Cancer Genome Atlas data to examine its overexpression and gene amplification across tumor types, its link to poor patient survival, and its potential as a therapeutic target in cancers with DNA repair defects.

title: Parenting, Ethnic Identity, and Psychopathology in Youth and Young Adults
gloss: Psychology research on whether ethnic identity exploration and commitment change how parenting practices relate to mental health symptoms such as anxiety, depression and aggression, using surveys of children aged 9-14 with their caregivers and of young adults recalling childhood parenting.

title: Narrative Transformation in Alcoholics Anonymous: The Redemptive Self and the American Story
