title: Infants Can Reason About Objects Even When They Are Hidden: Evidence from Containment Events
gloss: An infant cognition study of how hearing objects named with distinct names versus a shared category name shapes 12- and 16-month-olds' reasoning about hidden objects, using looking-time experiments with containment events run over Zoom. It examines early links between language and cognition.

title: Cortical Interneurons in the Mouse Model of Fragile X
gloss: Neuroscience research using a mouse model of Fragile X syndrome to study whether loss or dysfunction of inhibitory interneurons in the developing somatosensory cortex causes the excitation-inhibition imbalance linked to autism spectrum disorder, using fluorescent imaging to count interneurons and inhibitory synapses.

title: Method Matters: Including Critical Race Theory in the Academic Tradition of Qualitative Meaning Making
gloss: A literature-based study of how Critical Race Theory can be used as a framework in qualitative research, focusing on case study methodology, to center race and racism and validate the lived experiences of people of color in research design.

title: Developing a cFos Atlas to map brain activity
gloss: A neuroscience project building a whole-brain c-Fos activity atlas in mice to map which brain regions respond to light through retina-to-brain pathways (ipRGCs). It is relevant to circadian rhythms, mood and how light affects brain function and behavior.

title: Decoding Cave Wall Patterns to Search for Life Elsewhere
gloss: A geomicrobiology and astrobiology study of biovermiculations, worm-like microbial patterns on cave walls in a limestone cave, using microscopy, mapping and DNA analysis to test whether they are biological in origin and to help identify signs of life in caves on Mars and the Moon.

title: Auditory Processing and Behavioral Responses to Sound During Sleep
gloss: A sleep and dream study testing whether people can hear and respond to sounds while asleep, using trained sniffing responses, and when external sounds get incorporated into dreams across NREM and REM sleep stages.

title: PRL2 and the PTEN/PI3K/AKT signaling pathways in T-ALL
gloss: Studies whether the oncogene PRL2 drives pediatric T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) by disabling the PTEN tumor suppressor and activating PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling, using genetically engineered knockout mouse models to inform targeted cancer therapies.

title: How Crm1 Brings Genes to the Nuclear Edge-and the Proteins That Help It
gloss: A yeast genetics study of how the protein Crm1 positions genes at nuclear pores to regulate gene expression, using a genome-wide mutation screen to find partner proteins. The work connects nuclear organization of DNA to gene activity and to Crm1 overactivity in cancer.

title: Black Players, White Schools: How integration reshaped Southern college football
gloss: A history of the racial integration of Southern college football in the 1960s and 1970s, arguing it harmed the Black community by drawing talent, money, and attention away from HBCU football programs and toward predominantly white universities, using Black newspapers and other primary sources.

title: Novel Strategies for Assessing Awareness in the Borderlands between Sleep and Wake
gloss: A sleep and consciousness study using lucid dreaming techniques, auditory cues and EEG during naps to examine awareness at the transition from wakefulness to sleep, testing how well people perceive whether they are asleep or awake (sleep-state misperception).

title: When Silence Speaks: Comparing Conversational Delays in Schizophrenia and Depression
gloss: Compares pauses before answering questions (response latency) in clinical interviews of people with major depressive disorder and people at clinical high risk for psychosis, testing conversational turn-taking as a speech-based behavioral biomarker for early detection of psychosis.

title: Optimization of Carbon Black in Conversion Cathodes: Investigation of Additive Impurities
gloss: Battery materials research on lithium-ion batteries, studying how impurities in carbon black conductive additives affect the performance of iron fluoride conversion cathodes. The goal is higher-energy-density alternatives to cobalt- and nickel-based cathodes for electric vehicles and grid storage.

title: Say what again? Investigating the intelligibility of Formula 1 driver speech between situations, contexts, and language backgrounds
gloss: A linguistics study of speech intelligibility in noisy real-world settings, using recordings of Formula 1 drivers to test how background noise, native versus second-language English speakers, and contextual cues affect how well listeners understand speech.

title: AI-Assisted Validation of Transfer Data in Economic Research
gloss: Builds an AI-assisted system that extracts cash transfer amounts from development economics research papers and checks them against an existing meta-analysis dataset, automating data validation and error detection for research on global poverty interventions.

title: Fingerprinting Carbon Capture: Tracing Enhanced Rock Weathering Through Soil with Strontium Isotopes and Alkalinity
gloss: Geochemistry project on verifying carbon dioxide removal from enhanced rock weathering, combining strontium isotope ratios with alkalinity measurements to trace silicate weathering products from basalt-amended soils through soil profiles and improve carbon accounting for soil-based climate solutions.

title: Centralizing Search: How AI-Generated Summaries on Search Engine Results Pages Reshape User Engagement and Perception
gloss: A user study comparing AI-generated summaries with traditional link-based search results pages, examining how generative AI in search engines affects user attention, source clicking, perceived credibility, trust and satisfaction across health and pop culture searches.

title: Electrically Tunable Structural Color in Photonic Crystal Films of PEDOT:PSS-SiO2 for Electrochromic Devices
gloss: Develops electrochromic devices that use structural color from nanostructured PEDOT:PSS-silica photonic crystal films, where voltage changes particle spacing to tune color across the visible spectrum. Aimed at smart windows, displays, wearables and adaptive optical technologies.

title: Automated X-ray Analysis of Ice Formation in Drosophila Larvae
gloss: Studies how an insect antifreeze protein from a snowfly affects ice crystal formation inside fruit fly larvae, using X-ray diffraction and an automated Python pipeline for analyzing diffraction patterns. Relevant to biological freeze tolerance, cryopreservation and bioinspired antifreeze materials.

title: Exploring the Relationship between Adverse Childhood Experiences and the Development of Coping Strategies in Young Adults
gloss: A psychology survey study of how adverse childhood experiences shape the coping strategies young adults develop, also examining the roles of positive childhood experiences and personality traits in adaptive versus avoidant coping.

title: Understanding Causes of Altered Imitation in Autism: A Novel Hypothesis
gloss: A study of why autistic children have difficulty imitating gestures, comparing autistic and typically developing children to test whether breaking movements into step-by-step parts improves imitation and how much motor coordination versus non-motor processes explain the differences.

title: The Creeping Return of Antiquated Views on Womanhood: How Gen-Z Women Experience the Socio-Political Climate
gloss: An interview-based sociology study of how the current socio-political climate affects Gen-Z women's emotions, identity, and relationships, drawing on conversations with female Northwestern students about gender equity, political stress, solidarity among women, and the growing divide between young men and women.

title: Interpreting Justice: How Legal Practitioners Conceptualize Fairness, Justice, and their Role in the Changing Illinois Criminal Record Relief Landscape
gloss: An interview-based qualitative study of how legal aid lawyers understand justice, fairness, and their professional role in Illinois criminal record relief, including expungement and sealing under the Clean Slate Act. It examines how criminal justice policy reform is carried out in practice.

title: Repurposing ALOX5 Inhibition for Psoriasis Treatment
gloss: Immunology and dermatology research on psoriasis, using a CRISPR screen in human skin cells to find genes that regulate IL-17 inflammatory signaling. It tests repurposing an existing FDA-approved asthma drug as a topical psoriasis treatment in a mouse model.

title: Gender Differences in Self-Perceptions of ADHD Diagnosis: Identity, Relief, and Stigma
gloss: A psychology survey study of how young adults make sense of their ADHD diagnosis, comparing men and women on feelings of self-understanding, relief, and stigma, and examining how age at diagnosis relates to these perceptions.

title: Feedback-based Training and Musicality Teach People to Detect Deepfake Speech
gloss: A listening experiment testing whether short feedback-based training teaches people to tell real human speech from AI-generated deepfake voices, and whether musical ability and rhythm skills predict who detects voice deepfakes better and improves more with training.

title: Baseball's Highest Stakes Situation and a Decision Error Three Decades Deep
gloss: A sports analytics study of batter swing decisions in baseball with bases loaded and two outs, using a Markov decision process model and decades of Major League Baseball pitch data to show hitters swing too often, linked to behavioral economics ideas about action bias.

title: Identification of Host Ranges, Receptors, and Defense Genes For the JG024 Phage in Clinical Isolates of Pseudomonas Aeruginosa (PA)
gloss: Microbiology research on bacteriophage therapy against antibiotic-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa, testing which hospital clinical isolates a phage can infect and identifying the bacterial surface receptors and anti-phage defense genes that determine susceptibility or resistance, using bioinformatics, cloning and qPCR.

title: Targeting poison exon splicing to modulate CHD2 protein production
gloss: Gene therapy research on raising levels of CHD2, a gene linked to epilepsy, autism and intellectual disability, by using guide RNAs and a splicing factor to block a poison exon in its RNA. A splicing-based alternative for neurodevelopmental disorder genes too large for conventional gene therapy.

title: Linking niche diversity to phylogenetic relatedness in freshwater bacteria assemblies
gloss: Studies whether taxonomic classification of freshwater lake bacteria reflects their ecological function, using two decades of public DNA sequencing data from Lake Mendota to compare functional gene diversity across bacterial groups, including topological data analysis, with implications for revising bacterial taxonomy.

title: How Trait-Mindfulness and Working Alliance Predict Treatment Engagement in an Adolescent Mindfulness Study
gloss: Clinical psychology study of whether trait mindfulness and the coach-client working alliance predict how much at-risk adolescents engage with homework practice in a coach-delivered mindfulness and expressive writing intervention for preventing depression and anxiety.

title: From Scarcity to Solidarity: Mutual Aid as a Pathway to Food Sovereignty and Urban Resilience in Chennai, India
gloss: An interview-based study of community mutual aid networks in Chennai, India, and how they address food insecurity, food sovereignty and urban climate resilience. It examines grassroots groups and women's self-help groups in relation to caste, gender inequality and charity versus reciprocity.

title: Improving Medical Training to Address Health Literacy Gaps in Middle Eastern North African Americans
gloss: A public health study comparing health literacy between Middle Eastern and North African (MENA) Americans and White Americans using NIH All of Us data, showing how classifying MENA people as White hides health disparities and arguing for better demographic data and medical training.

title: The Role of Self-Concept Clarity in Decision-Making Under Time Pressure and Groupthink
gloss: A social psychology experiment on how self-concept clarity, groupthink, and time pressure affect conformity and argument quality in group decision-making, using a simulated corporate decision about recalling a defective medical device.

title: Signs of Change: A Cross-Cultural Exploration of Minority Language Revitalization through Linguistic Landscape
gloss: A cross-cultural sociolinguistics study of minority and Indigenous language revitalization, using photographs of public signage (linguistic landscape), ethnographic observation and interviews in Wales, South Africa, Singapore, the Philippines and New Zealand to examine language visibility, language policy and language hierarchies in post-colonial cities.

title: Synthesis of Cyanine-labeled Peptides for AuNP Labeling and Lysosomal Enzyme Detection
gloss: Chemistry project synthesizing "turn-on" fluorescent imaging probes that link cyanine dyes to gold nanoparticles through enzyme-cleavable peptides, so the dye lights up when cathepsins cut it free. The goal is detecting lysosomal enzyme activity tied to cancer invasion with less background signal.

title: Juvenile Regulatory T Cells Exhibit Decreased Capacity to Suppress Inflammation During Severe Influenza Pneumonia
gloss: Immunology research in mice comparing juvenile and adult regulatory T cells during severe influenza pneumonia, testing whether weaker Treg function in young animals explains prolonged lung inflammation and abnormal lung repair after viral infection in children.

title: Isolation and Characterization of Seven Novel Psuedomonas aeruginosa Bacteriophages
gloss: Isolates and characterizes new bacteriophages from wastewater that infect multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa, testing their host range against antibiotic-resistant clinical strains and examining their genomes and morphology, toward phage therapy as an alternative to antibiotics for hospital-acquired infections.

title: Neurotensin circuit regulation under approach-avoidance conflict
gloss: Neuroscience research in mice on how the neuropeptide neurotensin in the thalamus shapes reward seeking under risk, using an approach-avoidance conflict task with sucrose rewards and foot shocks, behavioral video scoring, and brain circuit mapping, relevant to anxiety and substance use disorders.

title: Optimization of Lipid Nanoparticle Formulation for Large Plasmid DNA Delivery
gloss: Bioengineering research on designing lipid nanoparticles to deliver large plasmid DNA as a non-viral gene delivery method, testing how lipid composition and microfluidic mixing flow rate affect nanoparticle size and DNA encapsulation efficiency.

title: Investigating the effects of bioactive peptides on peptide amphiphile nanofibers on an organoid spinal cord injury model
gloss: Tests an injectable peptide amphiphile nanofiber hydrogel that delivers regeneration-promoting peptides to spinal cord injuries, using a 3D human organoid injury model to study nerve regrowth and targeted drug delivery as a potential spinal cord injury therapy.

title: Graphene Oxide as an Environmentally Friendly Alternative to PFAS and Plastic in Paper Products
gloss: Develops a graphene oxide coating for recycled paper food packaging, such as grocery bags, as a sustainable alternative to PFAS and plastic barrier coatings, testing improvements in water resistance and mechanical strength.

title: Investigating Motor Thalamus Encoding of Forelimb Muscle Activity in Mice
gloss: A neuroscience study of how the motor thalamus and motor cortex in mice encode muscle activity during movement, using simultaneous brain and muscle recordings during a climbing task and regression models to compare how well each region predicts forelimb muscle activity.

title: Persistent Translation Validation
gloss: Speeding up translation validation for AI and LLM-based compiler transformations by splitting programs into persistent parts, such as memory structure, that stay unchanged across passes and non-persistent parts that must be re-verified, making it practical to use AI in compilation pipelines.

title: Engineering Vascularized Spinal Cord Organoids through Bioactive Peptide Amphiphile-Mediated Vascular Cell Integration
gloss: Tissue engineering project that adds blood vessel cells to stem cell-derived human spinal cord organoids, using bioactive peptide amphiphile biomaterials to promote vascular growth. The goal is better organoid models for studying spinal cord injury and regenerative therapies.

title: What We Say to Ourselves: Inner Speech, Neuroticism, and Psychological Flexibility
gloss: A psychology survey study of how the personality trait neuroticism and psychological flexibility relate to how often people talk to themselves in their heads and what that inner speech says, testing whether rumination links neuroticism to inner speech, with implications for emotion regulation and mental health.

title: Modeling Peripheral Artery Disease with Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissue
gloss: Tissue engineering project developing 3D engineered skeletal muscle tissues as a lab model of peripheral artery disease, testing hydrogel formulations and post surface treatments to find a simple, reproducible way to grow muscle tissue as an alternative to 2D cell cultures and animal models.

title: Playing the Supplicant: The Usurpation of Flattery in Shakespeare's Richard III
gloss: An English literature thesis on Shakespeare's Richard III, examining how Richard uses flattery to usurp the throne and arguing that it signals weakness and instability in his tyrannical rule, drawing on classical, medieval, and modern ideas about flattery and kingship.

title: Wearable Sweat Sensor for Chronic Kidney Disease Biomarkers
gloss: Develops a wearable colorimetric sweat sensor that measures urea and creatinine as a low-cost, non-invasive way to screen for chronic kidney disease, after comparing sweat and blood biomarker levels to show sweat can stand in for blood tests.

title: Sensory Neuron and Mast Cell Interaction in Itch Responses of Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB)
gloss: Studies how itch-related sensory nerves and immune mast cells interact to drive itch, pain and skin inflammation in recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, an inherited blistering skin disease, using a mouse model with tissue staining and imaging of skin and sensory ganglia.

title: Simulating the Phase Behavior of Polydisperse DNA-Nanoparticle Systems
gloss: Uses molecular dynamics simulations to map the phase behavior of DNA-coated nanoparticles of mixed sizes, studying how particle size differences and flexible DNA spacers affect their self-assembly into crystals. The work offers guidelines for designing programmable nanoparticle materials.

title: Potential Protectors of Genomic Stability in Keratinocytes
gloss: Studies whether the metabolic enzyme ACSS2 protects skin cells (keratinocytes) from genomic instability by stabilizing the DNA repair protein MSH6, relevant to skin cancer (cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma). Uses gene knockdown and a fluorescent reporter plasmid to detect microsatellite instability.

title: And Here I Am!" Chronotopic Memories in a Holocaust Survivor's Autobiographical Narratives
gloss: A narrative analysis of a Hungarian Holocaust survivor's recorded oral testimonies, using Bakhtin's chronotope to examine how survivor memory and self-understanding change across retellings and how narrators use time to make sense of past, present and future.

title: A Rat Model of Neonatal Encephalopathy: Exploring the Effects of Oxygen Deficiency on Central Auditory Function
gloss: Uses a rat model of neonatal encephalopathy to study how oxygen deprivation around birth affects hearing and central auditory function, measuring auditory brainstem responses in young rats exposed to low oxygen at different ages, relevant to hearing loss in preterm infants.

title: Dilute Plasmonic Copper Alloys: Leveraging Surface Engineering for Enhanced Catalysis
gloss: Studies low-cost copper-cobalt nanoparticles as light-responsive dilute plasmonic alloy catalysts, examining how gas environment and temperature reversibly change their surface composition and catalytic activity, with the aim of sustainable catalysis using earth-abundant metals instead of precious ones.

title: First-Year Transition Programs: an X Factor for the FGLI College Experience
gloss: Qualitative interview study of how first-year summer bridge and transition programs affect belonging, mental health, and academic adjustment for first-generation, low-income college students of color at a predominantly white university, using thematic coding of student interviews.

title: Territorial Membership: U.S. Naturalization Law and Defining Who Can Be American, 1897-1938
gloss: A sociolegal history study of how federal judges decided U.S. citizenship eligibility for people in American territories such as the Philippines, analyzing how race and territorial status shaped naturalization law and racial exclusion as the U.S. empire expanded.

title: Renaissance Mythological Afterlives: Transgressing Allusionary Bounds of the Lovers/Victims of Jove's Desire
gloss: A comparative literary analysis of how English Renaissance drama, including Shakespeare, Marlowe and Jonson, alludes to classical mythological women targeted by Jove's desire, examining how these allusions shape female subjectivity, embodiment and gender in Renaissance literature.

title: Elucidation of Urethane Exchange Mechanism with DABCO
gloss: Chemistry research on recycling thermoset polyurethane plastics by studying how the residual catalyst DABCO drives dynamic urethane bond exchange, using small molecule models to see how alcohol and urea affect the reaction, with the goal of reprocessing post-consumer polyurethane waste.

title: Hunger and Learning: How Food Deserts and Food Insecurity Shape Academic Success
gloss: A mixed-methods honors thesis on how food deserts and food insecurity affect academic success, combining regression analysis of Chicago Public Schools and USDA food access data with interviews of Northwestern students about the lived experience of hunger and educational inequality.

title: Living and Learning: Exploring the influence of place on students' communication about climate change across time during a local field trip
gloss: An education research study of place-based environmental learning, analyzing how fifth and sixth grade students from coastal, inland, urban and rural schools talk about climate change and marine ecosystem change after an informal science field trip, using transcript coding and statistical comparison.

title: Race and Real Estate: Nathan William MacChesney and the Consequential Establishment of Northwestern's Streeterville Campus
gloss: An archival history of Northwestern University's 1920s move of its medical schools from Chicago's South Side to Streeterville, focusing on trustee Nathan William MacChesney and how university real estate expansion connected to racial segregation through restrictive covenants, eugenics, and urban development.

title: Recognition without Responsiveness: Comparing the Turkish-Armenian and Armenian-American Communities
gloss: A comparative political science thesis on how state classification systems and minority recognition shape political voice for Armenian communities in the United States and Turkey, using interviews and ethnography to examine ethnic minority politics, multiculturalism, nationalism and genocide recognition.

title: Quantification, Spatial Analysis, and Source Attribution of Polynuclear Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs) in Chicago Soils
gloss: Measures soil contamination by carcinogenic polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in Chicago parks and public green spaces, mapping where pollution is highest and tracing it to sources such as vehicle traffic to assess human health risks from urban soil pollution.

title: Projecting the Public: A Framework for Constructing Empirical Visualization Studies of Broader Audiences
gloss: A study of research methods for data visualization studies with non-expert, general-public audiences. Using a literature review and interviews with visualization researchers, it develops a framework for designing such studies: recruiting participants, choosing study settings, and measuring how people engage with visualizations.

title: Hyperparameter Tuning in Causal ML Models: The Bayesian vs. Frequentist Approach
gloss: A thesis comparing Bayesian and standard automatic hyperparameter tuning in causal machine learning, testing whether better predictive accuracy leads to more accurate estimates of treatment effects. It sits at the intersection of machine learning and econometrics, focusing on how models for causal inference are configured.

title: Basal Body Temperature as a Noninvasive Marker of Menstrual Onset and Hormonal Dynamics in Adolescents
gloss: Tests whether nightly body temperature from a wearable ring can serve as a noninvasive marker of menstrual cycle timing and hormone fluctuations in adolescent girls, comparing temperature data with saliva hormone levels and self-reported periods to support puberty and brain development research.

title: Potential of AI Research Tool NotebookLM in Journalism
gloss: Evaluates how well Google's AI research tool NotebookLM helps journalists do background research in historical newspaper archives, testing timeline building, story summarization and tracking people and organizations, and examining accuracy, hallucinations and fact-checking of AI outputs in journalism.

title: Evaluating Human Pose Estimation Models in a Hospitalized Patient Population
gloss: Evaluates how well off-the-shelf computer vision pose estimation models detect body and facial keypoints in videos of hospitalized neurological patients, toward automated video-based patient monitoring for falls, delirium and seizures.

title: Bispecific Lipid Vesicles for Controlled Cargo Release and Enhanced Immunotherapy
gloss: Engineers drug-loaded lipid vesicles that bind both natural killer (NK) immune cells and HER2-positive cancer cells, releasing an inhibitor locally to keep NK cells' CD16 receptor from being shed. The goal is a synthetic biology approach to boost NK cell cancer-killing for cancer immunotherapy.

title: How Children's Health Insurance Reduces Crime: The Role of Behavioral Health Services in Medicaid
gloss: An economics thesis on how childhood Medicaid eligibility affects adult crime, using state eligibility differences and FBI arrest data. It tests whether education, financial stress, or access to mental health and substance abuse treatment explains the effect, finding behavioral health services to be the main pathway.

title: Potential New Regulators of Body Axis Formation in a Regenerating Marine Worm
gloss: Studies how the regenerating marine worm Hofstenia miamia patterns its head-to-tail body axis, testing whether the gene isthmin-like regulates Wnt signaling using RNAi knockdown, in situ hybridization and protein structure prediction, with possible relevance to Wnt-driven human cancers.

title: State Supreme Court Selection Mechanisms and Dissent
gloss: Studies how the way state supreme court justices are selected (partisan or nonpartisan elections, retention, or appointment) relates to how often and how they write dissents, using causal analysis and computational text analysis of dissent language to examine judicial independence and ideology.

title: Style Guide: Guiding the Institution and Beyond
gloss: A study of journalism style guides and how institutional guides like the Medill Stylebook can connect to the wider set of reporting standards. The project builds a database of affinity-specific, medium-specific and general style guides, analyzing their accessibility, relevance and interconnections to keep student-centered guides current.

title: Chemically Induced Dynein Relocalization in C. elegans Disrupts Faithful Meiosis
gloss: Studies how the location of the motor protein dynein affects egg cell meiosis in the worm C. elegans, using a chemical system to move dynein to spindle poles and examining chromosome misalignment, polar body extrusion failures and reduced embryo viability.

title: Greenland's earliest ecosystems after the last glaciation: Younger Dryas and early Holocene leaf wax analysis
gloss: Paleoclimate study of a Greenland lake sediment core, using leaf wax lipid biomarkers to reconstruct how vegetation and hydrology responded to Younger Dryas cooling and recovered in the early Holocene after the last glaciation, to give context for current ice sheet loss.

title: "A snack is not a meal": Culture, Identity, and Dietary Change in Malawi
gloss: A qualitative thesis on how Malawians adopt or resist Westernized and processed foods, using interviews, survey data and food-system history to examine how culture, identity, cost, health and hygiene beliefs, and social status shape dietary change in Africa.

title: From the Atlantic to the Lakeshore: Practicing Samba and Constructing Brasilidade in Chicago
gloss: A sociological study of the samba music and dance scene in Chicago, using interviews and participant observation to examine how samba groups teach and perform this Afro-Brazilian practice and how it shapes Brazilian identity, race, diaspora, and immigrant culture in the U.S.

title: Unleashed Horror in the Television: Examining Misrepresentations of the Insanity Plea in Contemporary Film and Television
gloss: A media and legal studies analysis of how contemporary film and television misrepresent the insanity defense, using close readings of crime and courtroom dramas to show how these portrayals spread public misconceptions about the law and the plea's legitimacy.

title: Nitrogen-nitrogen bond formation via electrochemistry
gloss: An organic chemistry project developing an electrochemical method to form nitrogen-nitrogen bonds between sp3-hybridized nitrogen atoms by oxidizing quinuclidine into a nitrogen radical. The resulting N-N bonded products are diversified into functionalized molecules relevant to medicinal chemistry and drug synthesis.

title: Women Between Worlds: American Wives as Cultural Ambassadors in Meiji Japan
gloss: A history thesis on American women in Meiji Japan who came as wives of diplomats and hired professionals, arguing they acted as informal two-way cultural ambassadors between Japan and the United States, based on their letters, diaries and published writings.

title: Mapping Movement Circuits: Projection-Specific Connectivity of Npas1+ Neurons in the Globus Pallidus Externa
gloss: Neuroscience research mapping the brain circuits of movement control, using genetic and viral tracing in mice to find where a subtype of globus pallidus neurons in the basal ganglia send their connections, with relevance to motor disorders such as Parkinson's disease.

title: Foreclosure to Financialization: Mapping Institutional Investor Penetration in SingleFamily Housing Markets After 2008
gloss: Spatial analysis of how institutional investors bought up single-family homes after the 2008 foreclosure crisis, mapping investor ownership in Atlanta, Charlotte and Jacksonville and its links to neighborhood income, race, housing equity and first-time homebuyer access.

title: Experiences of Racial Mismatch and Relationship to Racial Belonging
gloss: An interview study of how college students of color describe being taught mostly by White teachers in high school, and whether this student-teacher racial mismatch shaped their sense of racial and ethnic belonging and identity development.

title: @DarkHumor: Race-Blindness, Racism, and Racialization in Mexican Digital Discourse
gloss: Studies racism and race-blind ideology in Mexico by analyzing social media replies to a racist meme posted on X during the 2024 Mexican presidential election, showing how dark humor and categories like class, politics and religion are used to racialize people and sustain anti-Black and anti-Indigenous attitudes.

title: A Pattern Emerges: Investigating Snail Family Transcription Factors' Role in Ectodermal Gene Regulation Networks
gloss: A developmental biology study of how Snail family transcription factors shape gene regulatory networks that divide embryonic ectoderm into neural crest, central nervous system and skin, using gene knockdown and overexpression in frog (Xenopus) embryos to examine boundaries between cell fates.

title: Using Bio-compatible Conductive Hydrogels for On-Demand Drug Delivery
gloss: Develops electrically conductive, tissue-like hydrogels made of a conductive polymer in an alginate gel that release liposome-encapsulated chemotherapy drugs on demand when voltage is applied, aiming for localized, adjustable cancer drug delivery to solid tumors.

title: Modeling Histone Chaperone Interactions at the Replication Fork to Elucidate Mechanisms of Genomic Stability
gloss: Uses AI protein structure prediction (AlphaFold) and computational modeling to find new interactions between histone chaperones and DNA replication fork proteins, to understand how chromatin is disassembled and rebuilt during DNA replication and how this relates to genome stability and diseases such as cancer.

title: The Costs and Burden of In-Person Follow-Up After Pediatric Appendectomy
gloss: A retrospective study of the travel time, driving costs, caregiver wage loss, and carbon emissions that in-person follow-up visits impose on families after children's appendectomy surgery, informing comparisons with telemedicine-based postoperative care.

title: Theatre as Refuge: Facilitating Identity, Agency, and Belonging through Youth Migration Narratives at C:NTACT and Albany Park Theater Project
gloss: A thesis on how youth theatre companies in Copenhagen and Chicago use devised, identity-based theatre-making to build agency and belonging among migrant and refugee youth, and how these arts practices could be adapted into a model for refugee education.

title: Misdiagnosis and Overdiagnosis of Learning and Behavioral Disorders in Black Students
gloss: A paper examining racial disparities in how Black K-12 students are misdiagnosed and overdiagnosed with learning and behavioral disorders, using a cultural psychology approach to explore how cultural biases in Western psychology contribute to inequitable diagnosis and treatment in American schools.

title: A Deep Learning Approach to Minimum Medial and Lateral Joint Space Width Measurement
gloss: Develops a deep learning tool that automatically measures knee joint space width from X-ray images to track osteoarthritis progression, using image segmentation of knee radiographs to replace slow manual measurement in clinical and research settings.

title: A Deep Learning-Based Segmentation Model for Epithelial Cells Infected with Listeria monocytogenes
gloss: Develops a deep learning model for segmenting cell borders in fluorescence microscopy images of epithelial cells infected with the bacterium Listeria monocytogenes, training Cellpose-SAM on biosensor signals so infected cells and bacterial load can be quantified without a dedicated segmentation channel.

title: Investigating the Role of CARHSP1 in Stress Granule Formation and Metabolic Energy Production in Astrocytes
gloss: Cell and molecular neuroscience research on how astrocytes respond to cellular stress, studying the protein CARHSP1's role in stress granule formation and lactate energy production for neurons, with relevance to neurodegenerative diseases such as dementia with Lewy bodies.

title: Performing Equity, Missing Change: Exploring Teacher Perspectives on "Accountability Theater" in a Diverse Suburban High School
gloss: A sociology of education study using interviews with high school teachers to examine how a suburban school responded to pressure to reduce racial disparities in student discipline with performative policy compliance, and how teachers perceived these equity initiatives, classroom impacts, and trust in school leadership.

title: Extension of DNA Dendrimers through the Hybridization Chain Reaction
gloss: Synthesizes branched DNA dendrimers carrying initiator strands that drive the hybridization chain reaction to grow long DNA chains, aiming to build larger DNA structures that activate the cGAS-STING immune pathway against cancer. A DNA nanotechnology and cancer immunotherapy chemistry project.

title: "It's Okay Sometimes": Insights into Students' Nuanced Evaluations of Their Programming Ability While Using LLMs
gloss: Computing education research on how computer science students judge their own programming ability while coding with large language models (LLMs) like AI chatbots. Uses qualitative and quantitative surveys to examine student self-assessment, self-efficacy, and critical thinking about AI use in introductory programming courses.

title: An Uncertain Peace: Armed Groups, Civilian Disputes, and the Limits of State Presence in Postwar Colombia
gloss: A political science study of postwar Colombia after the 2016 FARC peace accords, using surveys and interviews to examine how the continued presence of armed groups affects whether civilians turn to the state or other actors to resolve disputes, and their trust in state institutions.

title: Platelets drive immune suppression and glioblastoma growth in a sex-dependent manner via PAR4 signaling
gloss: Cancer biology research on how platelets suppress the immune system and promote glioblastoma brain tumor growth differently in females and males. The project examines platelet PAR4 signaling, estrogen, and T-cell responses as potential targets for sex-specific brain cancer treatment.

title: Proteomimetic Polymer for Neuron-Targeted Delivery.
gloss: Synthesizes protein-like polymers built from the neuron-binding Tet-1 peptide to deliver therapeutics to brain cells for neurodegenerative diseases. The fluorescently labeled polymers were characterized and tested for neuronal targeting and cell uptake, as a drug delivery platform that overcomes peptide instability.

title: Identifying Block Design Task Completion Strategies With Machine Learning
gloss: Uses sensor-embedded blocks and machine learning to automatically analyze how people solve the Block Design Task, a spatial thinking puzzle, identifying differences in participants' problem-solving strategies through time series clustering instead of manual video review.

title: What's the junction's function? Quantifying molecular load of dynamic crosslinks in polymer networks.
gloss: Polymer chemistry research on how recyclable, self-healing plastics called covalent adaptable networks fail under mechanical stress. The project uses force-sensitive mechanophore molecules and fluorescence to measure how much load dynamic crosslinks carry, aiming at sustainable replacements for thermosets.

title: Combination Treatment of DFMO and Navitoclax for Medulloblastoma, a Childhood Brain Cancer
gloss: Lab study testing a sequential drug combination against medulloblastoma, a childhood brain cancer, in cancer cell lines: DFMO pushes tumor cells into senescence and the senolytic drug Navitoclax then kills the senescent cells, a pediatric cancer therapy approach measured by cell viability.

title: Exploring How Aggressive Immigration Policies and Anti-Immigrant Rhetoric Affect Latino Immigrant Health
gloss: A literature-based study of how anti-immigrant rhetoric and aggressive immigration enforcement act as social determinants of health for Latino immigrants in the United States, affecting physical and mental health through stress, fear of deportation, and healthcare avoidance, framing immigration policy as public health policy.

title: Language Matters; How Adults with Food Insecurity Perceive the Term "Binge Eating"
gloss: A qualitative interview study of how adults experiencing food insecurity understand and react to the term "binge eating" versus alternatives like "emotional eating" or "overeating," examining how eating disorder terminology affects stigma, help-seeking and outreach for digital interventions.

title: Precision In Situ Measurement of Rotor Wobble in the ARIADNE Axion Experiment
gloss: Develops a fiber-optic laser interferometer method to measure the wobble of a spinning tungsten rotor in ARIADNE, a dark matter (axion) search experiment, so the rotor can operate safely near a quantum sensor at cryogenic temperatures and high vacuum.

title: Construction of the Deportable Body: The Ontology of "Reasonable Suspicion" and Noem V. Vasquez Perdomo
gloss: A thesis examining how the Fourth Amendment reasonable suspicion standard has become a tool for racial profiling in U.S. immigration enforcement, focusing on the 2025 Supreme Court case Noem v. Vasquez Perdomo and its targeting of Latine people.

title: Historical Knowledge: Development of Normative Data for Historical Misconceptions Study
gloss: A cognitive psychology project developing and norming a set of trivia questions about recent and distant U.S. historical events, to be used in experiments on how psychological distance affects belief in historical misinformation. It examines how people's confidence, topic familiarity and answer accuracy relate.

title: Impact of Myeloid-Specific MyD88 Deficiency on Inflammatory Cell Responses Following Lung Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury in Latent MCMV Infection
gloss: Immunology research using a myeloid-specific MyD88 knockout mouse model to study how innate immune signaling shapes inflammation and viral control after lung ischemia-reperfusion injury in latent cytomegalovirus infection, relevant to lung transplant complications.

title: All Cracked Up: How Solvents Stress Out Hydrogels
gloss: Studies how drying causes cracking, peeling and fracture in PEG-based hydrogels used in biomedical and soft robotic applications. It examines how solvent volatility, crosslinking density and gel thickness affect drying-induced stress, with the aim of designing more durable hydrogels.

title: Food Difficulties Associated with Autism Spectrum Disorder and Travel Experiences
gloss: A psychology survey study of how autism-related food difficulties, such as picky eating, sensory sensitivities and reliance on familiar foods, affect autistic adults' experiences of travel, including stress around finding food in new places.

title: Examining the Relationship Between Musical Sophistication and Technologically Mediating Listening Experiences
gloss: A music psychology survey study of how listening habits on music streaming platforms relate to musical sophistication, using psychometric questionnaires to examine listener types, awareness of algorithmic recommendation systems, and intentional versus passive music consumption.

title: Antisense Oligonucleotide-Mediated Knockdown of ZFP423 in Adipose Tissue Enhances Thermogenesis and Improves Metabolic Health
gloss: Mouse study testing antisense oligonucleotide drugs that knock down the fat-tissue gene ZFP423 to promote beige fat and thermogenesis, as a potential therapy for obesity and diabetes, with links to circadian disruption and metabolic health.

title: Self similarity of Fractals
gloss: A pure mathematics project on fractal geometry that studies how the Hausdorff dimension of classical fractals such as the Cantor set and Sierpinski gasket changes under transformations like scaling, nonlinear distortions and projections, examining when fractal complexity is preserved or reduced.

title: Engineering Galectin-mimicking Nanoparticles for Targeting Lung Cancer
gloss: Develops nanoparticles coated with peptides derived from galectins, sugar-binding proteins, to target glycans overexpressed on lung cancer cells. The project tests whether these nanoparticles bind cancer cells more selectively than immune cells, toward targeted drug delivery and study of tumor-immune interactions.

title: Efficacy of Tomivosertib (MNK1/2 Inhibitor) in Mitigating Pain in a Mouse Model of Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
gloss: Tests whether blocking the MNK signaling pathway with the drug tomivosertib reduces chronic nerve pain in a mouse model of recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, a genetic blistering skin disease, measuring pain-related gene activity in sensory nerves and pain behaviors.

title: Modeling the Variability in Breast Cancer Resistance Outcomes
gloss: Mathematical modeling of drug resistance in breast cancer, using a probabilistic framework where cell division and death probabilities vary continuously rather than following fixed cell states, applied to public data on breast cancer cells treated with targeted therapy and chemotherapy.

title: Tunable Permeability of Peptide-Brush-Polymers
gloss: Molecular dynamics simulations of peptide-brush polymers for peptide drug delivery, studying how backbone hydrophobicity affects their ability to cross cell membranes. A computational chemistry and biophysics project on designing more cell-permeable peptide therapeutics.

title: Therapeutic Targeting of Chromosome Damage in Drug Resistant Brain Cancer
gloss: Cancer biology research on drug-resistant glioblastoma, studying how the chemotherapy temozolomide causes telomere and chromosome damage (chromothripsis) and whether resistant brain cancer cells become vulnerable to nuclear export inhibitor drugs like Selinexor, using cell experiments and patient samples.

title: Inclusive Writing in the French-speaking World: A Study of Governmental and University Policies in Canada, France, and Belgium
gloss: A comparative study of gender-inclusive writing in French, examining how government and university language policies in Canada, France, and Belgium support or restrict practices like feminized job titles, gender-neutral terms, and the mid-dot.

title: Exposing Hidden Risks: The Impact of Laws Targeting Nonfatal Strangulation on Intimate Partner Violence
gloss: An economics thesis evaluating how U.S. state laws criminalizing nonfatal strangulation affect intimate partner violence, including domestic violence reporting, police arrests and intimate partner homicide, using crime data and a difference-in-differences policy analysis.

title: Reassessing v-Blockers in HFpEF: Prescribing Patterns And Outcomes In The Cardiometabolic Center Alliance Registry
gloss: Analysis of patient registry data on how often beta-blockers are prescribed to adults with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), and whether their use is linked to hospitalizations or fainting, examining possible overprescription of these heart medications.

title: PATH: A Structured Reflection Tool for Understanding and Addressing the Interplay among Emotions, Beliefs, Metacognition, and Actions in CS1
gloss: Computing education research on why introductory programming students struggle, linking self-beliefs, emotions, metacognition and ineffective behaviors like brute-forcing. The project builds PATH, a structured reflection tool, compares it with free-form journaling, and identifies distinct pathways of student struggle in CS1.

title: Understanding how hearing loss and cognitive change impact older adult communication
gloss: Audiology and aging study comparing hearing aids and communication strategy training, delivered in different orders, for improving conversation between older adults with hearing loss and dementia or mild cognitive impairment and their partners, using video-recorded conversation tasks.

title: Trust or Bust? Investigating Cultural Variations in Physician-Patient Interactions
gloss: A cross-cultural psychology study comparing how patients in Ghana and the United States perceive physician empathy and how it relates to patient satisfaction, examining the role of collectivist versus individualistic cultural values in doctor-patient relationships.

title: Corticotropin-Releasing Factor in the Medial Prefrontal Cortex Modulates Fear Generalization in a Sex-Specific Manner
gloss: Neuroscience study in mice of how stress neuropeptide signaling in the prefrontal cortex drives fear generalization, a PTSD symptom, using fear conditioning, fiber photometry, optogenetics and drugs, and finding sex differences between male and female mice.

title: "I'm Grateful that I Had a First-Gen Experience": A Qualitative Study of the Strengths of First-Generation Professionals
gloss: A qualitative interview study of first-generation college graduates working in nonprofit, philanthropy, and higher education careers, exploring the strengths they draw from their backgrounds, the challenges they face at work, and how mentorship and workplace support help them succeed.

title: Policy and Perception: How Legislation Shapes Gen Z Attitudes Toward Sex Work in the Netherlands and the U.S.
gloss: A sociology interview study comparing how young women in the Netherlands and the United States view sex work, testing whether laws legalizing or banning prostitution shape public attitudes or whether cultural context matters more.

title: Understanding the Interaction Between Self-perceived Hearing Metrics, Demographic Characteristics, and Hearing Aid Retention
gloss: Studies why adults keep or return hearing aids after a trial, comparing over-the-counter self-fit and audiologist-fit devices, and how self-perceived hearing handicap, perceived benefit, and demographics such as age, education, and income relate to hearing aid retention, using data from a randomized controlled trial.

title: Size-Dependent Delivery of Gold Nanoparticle Single-Chain Variable Fragment Conjugate for Early Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease
gloss: Develops a molecular imaging probe for early diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease, made of gold nanoparticles linked to an antibody fragment that targets amyloid-beta oligomers. The work covers nanoparticle synthesis and characterization, brain tissue imaging, and planned delivery and biodistribution studies in neuron cultures and a mouse model.

title: The Effects of Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) Policy on College Football Winning Percentages
gloss: An economics thesis on how college athlete name, image, and likeness (NIL) payments affect college football team success, using university NIL spending data and regression analysis to test whether more NIL funding buys more wins in college sports.

title: Investigating Spatial Restriction as a Cue to Improve In Vitro Syncytium Formation
gloss: Develops a lab-grown model of the human placenta's maternal-fetal barrier, a mini-syncytium-on-chip, using micropatterning to confine cells in defined shapes and test whether spatial restriction improves cell fusion into a syncytium, for use in drug safety testing and pregnancy complication research.

title: Determining the trajectory and origin of the X-ray binary source Hercules X-1
gloss: Uses Gaia satellite astrometry and orbit integration to trace the galactic orbit of the X-ray binary star system Hercules X-1 back in time, to find where it was ejected from by its neutron star's supernova (the galactic plane or a globular cluster) and whether its supernova remnant can be found.

title: Optimizing MS2 Virus-Like Particle Assembly Around Nucleic Acid Cargo for Drug Delivery
gloss: Studies how to package DNA and RNA cargo inside virus-like particles made from the MS2 bacteriophage for drug delivery, developing reliable methods to measure encapsulation yield and a more reproducible capsid reassembly protocol, and examining how cargo type and structure affect packaging efficiency and particle stability.

title: Investigating differences in cytoskeletal organization between dendritic cell subtypes during their migration.
gloss: Immunology and cell biology research comparing how two dendritic cell subtypes reorganize their cytoskeleton to protect the nucleus while migrating through confined spaces, using migration assays and immunofluorescence microscopy to test the role of the DOCK8 pathway linked to immunodeficiency disorders.

title: Examining Functional Genomic Variation in Symbiodiniaceae associated with Acropora cervicornis Coral
gloss: Studies the symbiotic algae living in the endangered Caribbean staghorn coral Acropora cervicornis, using RNA sequencing to compare symbiont gene expression and community composition between heat-sensitive and heat-resistant corals, to understand coral bleaching, heat tolerance and reef conservation under ocean warming.

title: t6A Inhibition Decreases Cell Proliferation of Cisplatin Resistant Ovarian Cancer Cells and May Alter Protein Translation Dynamics
gloss: Cancer biology research on how blocking t6A, a tRNA modification, affects protein translation and cell growth in chemotherapy (cisplatin) resistant and sensitive ovarian cancer cells, with the aim of boosting neoantigen production for immunotherapy.

title: Understanding the Clinical Experiences of Human Trafficking and Domestic Violence Survivors in Illinois
gloss: A survey study of adult human trafficking and domestic violence survivors in Illinois shelters about their healthcare experiences, examining whether clinicians screened for and recognized abuse or exploitation, to inform trauma-informed screening, provider education and policy.

title: Compensatory Mechanisms of Avoidant Attachment
gloss: Social psychology survey research on romantic relationships and attachment styles, examining how people perceive avoidant and anxious attachment behaviors in partners and what keeps people committed to and satisfied with avoidantly attached partners.

title: Hardware- and Noise-Aware Quantum Compilation of Fermionic Hamiltonians
gloss: Builds a quantum compiler that turns fermionic Hamiltonians, used to simulate molecules and materials, into hardware circuits while accounting for qubit connectivity, gate fidelity and noise. Extends a ternary-tree compilation method to reduce costly qubit interactions and two-qubit gate error rates.

title: Microglia Depletion Does Not Impact CD8+ T Cell Infiltration Into The Young Mouse Brain 8 Hours Post-Traumatic Brain Injury
gloss: Neuroimmunology study in young mice testing whether depleting microglia, the brain's resident immune cells, changes CD8+ T cell infiltration into the brain shortly after traumatic brain injury, examining how immune responses to brain injury differ with age.

title: Lauroyl-MBEH-Loaded Nanoparticles as a Targeted Anti-Melanoma Treatment
gloss: Develops a targeted melanoma cancer treatment using nanoparticles loaded with a derivative of the drug MBEH, which targets the melanin-producing pathway, and compares it with the free drug using cell viability and cytotoxicity assays in a nanomedicine and drug delivery study.

title: From Pollution to Products: Upgrading CO2 Emissions Using Electricity
gloss: Uses electrocatalysis driven by renewable electricity to convert captured carbon dioxide into a precursor of acrylic acid through electrochemical carboxylation, offering a greener alternative to fossil fuel-based chemical manufacturing and reducing the chemical industry's carbon emissions.

title: Epigenetic Loss of Fibrillin-1 Drives Ovarian Fibrosis During Reproductive Aging
gloss: Biology research on ovarian aging and fibrosis in mice, studying how epigenetic loss of the extracellular matrix protein fibrillin-1 increases TGF-beta signaling and scarring in aging ovaries, with implications for infertility and preserving reproductive function.

title: Remixing and Reliving: The interethnic power of intergenerational sampling in Bronx and London Hip-Hop
gloss: An ethnomusicological and historical study of sampling in hip-hop, comparing Bronx and London scenes to show how borrowing from older music reflects interethnic community ties among Puerto Rican, African diasporic, and Caribbean populations, with a case study of A Tribe Called Quest.

title: Foreign Accent Detection With and Without Language Familiarity: Evidence from Korean
gloss: A linguistics and speech perception study testing whether listeners who do not know Korean can still tell native from non-native (foreign-accented) Korean speech, comparing listeners with different language backgrounds to examine language-general versus language-specific cues to foreign accent.

title: Salmonella in the Human Gut: Understanding Its Survival Strategy via an Encapsulated Metabolic Pathway
gloss: Combines mathematical modeling and microbiology experiments to study how Salmonella survives in the inflamed human gut using a metabolic pathway enclosed in a protein shell (bacterial microcompartment), examining shell permeability and how environmental conditions drive compartment formation, with applications to disease control and metabolic engineering.

title: Loneliness and cognitive functioning in everyday life among mid-to-later life adults
gloss: Psychology study of how everyday feelings of loneliness relate to cognitive functioning in middle-aged and older adults, using smartphone-based ecological momentary assessments and mobile cognitive tests of processing speed, memory and working memory in daily life.

title: Measuring What Matters: Evaluating Language Exposure Tool in Bilingual Toddler Research
gloss: Studies how home exposure to Spanish and English changes over time in bilingual toddlers and how it relates to language dominance, using parent interviews and vocabulary reports from a longitudinal child language study, and evaluates the limitations of a language exposure measurement tool.

title: Missing from the Model: The Gender Imbalance in Undergraduate Economics at Northwestern University
gloss: A qualitative interview study of the gender gap in undergraduate economics at Northwestern, examining how department culture, extracurricular clubs and career expectations around finance and consulting shape women's experiences and contribute to the leaky pipeline for women in economics.

title: Exploring Dyadic Perspectives of Friendship Jealousy on Relationship Maintenance and Individual Well-Being
gloss: A social psychology study of jealousy in adult friendships, examining how it affects both the jealous friend and the friend receiving it, including emotions like shame and exhaustion and ways conflicts get resolved. Uses interviews with young adults and AI-classified TikTok comments.

title: Is SpeechLLM Safety Sufficient?
gloss: Studies the security of AI voice assistants built on speech large language models, testing whether hidden or misleading audio instructions can jailbreak them into harmful behavior. Builds an evaluation framework and a benchmark dataset of audio attack prompts to compare open and commercial models and their safety defenses.

title: Targeted Synthesis of Protein-like Polymers as JAK2 Inhibitor in Intracellular Pathway of Alopecia
gloss: Synthesis of protein-like polymers that mimic the natural protein SOCS1 to selectively inhibit JAK2 and calm overactive immune signaling, tested in human skin cells as a safer potential treatment for alopecia areata and other inflammatory skin diseases.

title: A Supersensitive ELISA for Detecting Amyloid-v Oligomers in Alzheimer's Disease and Its Potential Diagnostic Utility
gloss: Develops a highly sensitive antibody-based ELISA assay to detect toxic amyloid-beta oligomers in brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid from mice, rats and humans, as a potential early diagnostic test for Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment.

title: Characterizing the Secretory Mechanism of a Novel Peptide Through an RNAi Screen in Drosophila
gloss: Studies how a small peptide from a short open reading frame is secreted without a signal peptide in fruit fly (Drosophila) ovaries, using an RNAi knockdown screen of secretion genes to investigate noncanonical protein secretion and transport from follicle cells to the oocyte.

title: Estrogen Receptor-a Expression in Serotonergic Neurons of the Dorsal Raphe in Male and Female Mice: Implications for Estrogenic Modulation of Serotonergic Circuits
gloss: Neuroscience study mapping where estrogen receptor-alpha is expressed in serotonin-producing neurons of the dorsal raphe in male and female mice, using a fluorescent reporter mouse line and immunofluorescent brain imaging, to understand how estrogen may influence serotonin circuits involved in mood and neuropsychiatric disorders.

title: Optimizing dimensionality reduction in gene expression using autoresearch
gloss: Uses autoresearch, where large language models automate coding experiments, to find low-dimensional representations of human brain gene expression data, compared against manual dimensionality reduction such as PCA. The project designs prompts and constraints for agentic coding and tests it as an automated approach to machine learning model selection.

title: Assessment of Comorbid Depressive Symptoms in Clinical High-Risk for Psychosis Research
gloss: A meta-analysis of how depression and depressive symptoms are measured in research on people at clinical high risk for psychosis, examining which assessment tools studies use and how depression screening varies by world region and relates to psychosis transition rates.

title: Not All Setbacks Are Equal: How the Brain Responds to Failure Shapes Recovery and Motivation in Adolescents
gloss: An fMRI brain imaging study of how middle school adolescents' neural responses to failure and negative feedback relate to their recovery, learning, motivation, and symptoms of depression and anxiety. It examines teen brain development and mental health.

title: SnapVac: An Innovation in Video Laryngoscopy
gloss: A medical device design project creating a 3D-printed suction attachment for video laryngoscopes that clears fluids from the airway during emergency intubation, aiming to improve visibility, reduce repeated intubation attempts, and lower complication risk. Prototypes were tested on an intubation mannequin with feedback from ER physicians.

title: Characteristics of Measures Used to Assess Working Memory Across Studies Focused on Children with Specific Reading Comprehension Deficits
gloss: A meta-analysis and systematic review of executive function, especially working memory, in children with specific reading comprehension deficits, describing the types and formats of working memory tests used across studies of reading disabilities.

title: Analyzing Geometry of the Environment to Inform Mice's Peeking Behavior
gloss: Animal behavior research on how mice use peeking from cover to gather information about a robot predator while navigating a maze, testing whether they peek at locations predicted to best reduce uncertainty about the threat's position.

title: Investigating Individual Differences in Block Assembly Strategies
gloss: A spatial cognition study of the strategies people use to solve the Block Design Task, a common test of spatial ability. Videos of undergraduates rebuilding colored-block designs were coded to classify their assembly strategies and understand individual differences in spatial problem solving.

title: The Impact of Hypoxic Exposure on Nervous System Development in Neonate Rats
gloss: Neuroscience study using newborn rat pups as a model of premature birth to test how brief early-life oxygen deprivation (hypoxia) affects nervous system development, measuring sensorimotor behavior, scent-guided maze navigation, hearing via auditory brainstem response, growth and survival.

title: Deductive Proof vs. Model Checking for Safety Verification of Autonomous Physical Systems
gloss: Compares formal verification methods (model checking with TLA+ and nuSMV versus deductive proof in Lean 4) for proving the safety of a controlled 3D drone model, weighing guarantee strength, proof effort and scalability for safety-critical autonomous systems.

title: Dissecting Mental Rotation Tests: How Stimuli Influence Children's Spatial Performance
gloss: A meta-analysis of studies on young children's spatial thinking, examining how the design of mental rotation tests, specifically animate versus inanimate stimuli, affects children's performance and what this means for valid cognitive assessment in developmental psychology.

title: High-Throughput Discovery of Trispecific Antibodies for Cancer Therapies Using MegaMolecules
gloss: Uses a modular protein assembly platform called MegaMolecules to build and screen a large library of trispecific antibodies targeting breast cancer cell surface receptors, aiming to speed discovery of multispecific antibody immunotherapies for cancer.

title: TEAMSTaR: Designing and Testing Tools for Space Team Success
gloss: Tests a teamwork dashboard and intervention activities meant to help astronaut crews make decisions and improve team performance during long space missions, studied in NASA ground-based analog missions. Also covers how to run real-time human subject research and survey data collection in spaceflight analog settings.

title: Development of a Fluorescence-Based Endomicroscope System for Quantitative Assessment of Pediatric Aspiration
gloss: Biomedical engineering project building a fluorescence endomicroscope, a medical imaging device that detects and counts fluorescent particles in lung tissue to directly measure aspiration (inhaling foreign material into the lungs) in children, aiming to replace qualitative swallow studies with quantitative diagnosis.

title: Application of Red Fluorescent PLGA Microspheres for Quantitative Assessment of Pediatric Aspiration
gloss: Develops a quantitative method for diagnosing pediatric aspiration (food or liquid entering the airway) using red fluorescent biodegradable polymer microspheres as tracers, tested for detection and counting in animal airway and lung tissue models as an alternative to qualitative swallow studies.

title: Evaluation of Heavy Metal Contamination and Social Correlates in Chicago Community Areas
gloss: Measures heavy metal contamination in urban soil across Chicago neighborhoods and links it to income and race, an environmental justice study combining community-based soil sampling, chemical analysis, census demographics and GIS mapping to identify at-risk communities and inform environmental policy.

title: Romance and Report Cards: The Effect of Romantic Relationship Commitment on Perceived Academic Performance
gloss: A psychology survey study of undergraduates examining whether being in a romantic relationship, and how serious it is, affects college students' self-reported academic performance, with sleep duration also examined as a factor.

title: Toward Autonomous Breathing: Predicting CO2 in Children with CCHS Using Wearable Sensors
gloss: Uses wearable sensor data and machine learning to predict carbon dioxide levels in children with congenital central hypoventilation syndrome, a breathing control disorder, toward automatic real-time adjustment of phrenic nerve stimulation for assisted ventilation.

title: Storytelling & Video Editing for Protest Tradition: The NBA Bubble Podcast
gloss: A podcast examining athlete protest and racial justice activism during the 2020 NBA bubble season amid COVID-19 and Black Lives Matter, asking whether the player work stoppage was genuine protest. The project involved storytelling, video editing and promotional content production for sports and politics media.

title: Functionalizing Yarns with Dip Coating for Smart Knitted Haptic Tactile Interfaces
gloss: Develops a low-cost dip coating process to make insulated conductive yarns that work in knitting machines, enabling smart knitted textiles with embedded sensing. The yarns are used to knit capacitive pressure sensor arrays and triboelectric nanogenerators for haptic interfaces and wearable electronics.

title: Creating Four Isogenic Strains with Different Prion states in Yeast
gloss: Molecular biology research on yeast prions, creating genetically identical strains of baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) that carry different combinations of prion and non-prion protein states. The work relates to inherited protein misfolding and aggregation, which is linked to prion neurodegenerative diseases such as Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.

title: Assessing the Effect of Substrate Temperature on Egg Laying Behavior of Fruit Flies
gloss: Studies how substrate temperature influences where female fruit flies (Drosophila) choose to lay their eggs, using a new two-choice temperature assay, comparing species from different thermal environments, and using genetic tools to identify the thermosensory neurons behind this egg-laying decision.

title: Akh and Hh Pathway Role on Calcium Level
gloss: Studies how Adipokinetic Hormone (AKH) and Hedgehog signaling pathways interact to control calcium signaling in the fruit fly (Drosophila) larval fat body during starvation. Uses fluorescent calcium imaging to examine how fat metabolism and energy use are regulated.

title: Fingertip-Sized Wireless Button Sensors for Health Monitoring in Neonatal and Pediatric Patients
gloss: Development of miniaturized wireless wearable sensors that continuously monitor vital signs such as heart rate, breathing, blood oxygen and brain activity in premature infants in the NICU, streaming data to a smartphone app so clinicians can track patients without wired monitors.

title: Optimizing Thrust Performance in Hybrid Rocket Engines through Fuel Grain Geometry and Boundary Condition Modifications
gloss: Experimental and computational study of how fuel grain port geometry and boundary conditions affect thrust and fuel regression in hybrid rocket engines, comparing 3D-printed cylindrical, helical and finned-helical ABS fuel grains through static hotfire tests and computational fluid dynamics simulations.

title: Hh Role in Drosophila Anterior Fat Body and Pathway of Calcium Repression
gloss: Fruit fly (Drosophila) genetics study of how fat body tissue releases energy during starvation, using calcium imaging in larvae to examine how Adipokinetic Hormone and Hedgehog signaling pathways interact to control calcium signaling and fat metabolism.
